hindi: जिसका आठ नंबर का वरुण देवता है उसमें तूफान लाके तो दिखाओ वो व्यक्ति तूफान आने ही नहीं देगा अपने अंदर वो पागल होएगा ही नहीं
says: For someone with Neptune in sign 8 (Scorpio), try bringing a storm: he will not let a storm arise inside him and will never lose his head.
cells_derived_method: Neptune in Scorpio makes the person emotionally steady and unmoved.

derived_examples.reading: Neptune in 1st in Scorpio: very composed nature, poker-faced.
Neptune in 5th in Scorpio: intense but controlled creativity and love.
Neptune in 10th in Scorpio: calm under public pressure.

ambiguity: 'आठ नंबर का' is read as the sign number 8, but could also mean the 8th house; his earlier sentence says 'आठ नंबर स्थिर राशि है', so sign is the likely meaning.

hindi: अरे एक नंबर वाले को बोल दो चार नंबर वाले को बोल दो वो तूफान मचा देगा तांडव उसको बोलो शू भाग लिया फुर गाड़ी तोड़फाड़ मचा दिया फिर बोलो भाई मैं तो टॉमी को कह रहा था तू क्यों निकल लिया उसको संभालना असंभव है
says: Tell someone with Neptune in sign 1 (Aries) or sign 4 (Cancer) 'shoo' and he will cause a storm and a rampage, smashing things; he cannot be handled even if you say you meant the dog.
cells_derived_method: Neptune in a movable sign (Aries, Cancer) gives an explosive reaction to small slights. House shows the area where the reaction shows.

derived_examples.reading: Neptune in 1st in Aries: personal temper explodes.
Neptune in 4th in Cancer: domestic outbursts and smashed household things.
Neptune in 7th in Aries: partner reacts with fury to small signals.

ambiguity: The humorous dog story is mixed in with a real claim. He says 'एक नंबर और चार नंबर' for signs 1 and 4.

hindi: 12 नंबर की राशि हो द्व स्वभाव है।
says: Sign 12 (Pisces) is a dual-natured sign.
cells_derived_method: Neptune in Pisces (dual water) has a double nature.

derived_examples.reading: Neptune in 12th in Pisces: double-minded and drawn to both reality and illusion.
Neptune in 6th in Pisces: unclear health and service matters, both help and trouble.

classical_check: Agrees: Pisces is a dual sign.

hindi: वो जा भी सकता है, नहीं भी जा सकता।
says: With Neptune in a dual sign he may go or may not go; he cannot be pinned down to a decision.

derived_examples.reading: Neptune in 7th in Pisces: unable to decide to commit or leave.
Neptune in 10th in Pisces: indecision on career moves.

hindi: ना वो इधर का है ना वो उधर का है।
says: He belongs to neither side; he is neither here nor there.
cells_derived_method: Neptune in Pisces gives a person who is on neither side.

derived_examples.reading: Neptune in 9th in Pisces: belongs to no single faith.
Neptune in 3rd in Pisces: communication that never takes a firm side.

hindi: वो डुअलिटी का देवता है।
says: Neptune in a dual sign makes him the god of duality.
cells_derived_method: Neptune in Pisces is the god of duality.

hindi: ऐसे व्यक्ति से अगर आपने बात करनी शुरू की कि भगवान है या नहीं है तो आपने अपने सिर के ऊपर हथड़ा मार लिया।
says: If you begin to debate with such a person whether God exists, you have hit your own head with a hammer; you will lose.
cells_derived_method: Neptune in Pisces gives an endless debater; the debate is not winnable.

derived_examples.reading: Neptune in 3rd in Pisces: argues any side with fluent speech.
Neptune in 9th in Pisces: shifts between belief and disbelief as suits.

ambiguity: Humorous advice.

hindi: क्योंकि वो दोनों तरफ से बात कर
says: He can argue both sides of any question (sentence continues in the next chunk).
cells_derived_method: Neptune in a dual sign argues from both sides.
ambiguity: Sentence cut by the chunk boundary; ends with 'सकता है'.

gist: Completes the previous sentence: he can talk from both sides.
Dialogue example: What are you saying? God exists.
Dialogue example: I will prove that He does not.
After three hours of fighting you lay down your weapons.
He says my show is complete.
He says: sir, here comes my friend, talk to him.
You are now convinced that God does not exist.
You have been made to believe it.
Now you begin arguing: sir, there is no God.
The next friend, also under Neptune, convinces you again in three hours that He exists.

hindi: वो इधर की भी बहस करेगा उधर की भी बहस करेगा।
says: A person with strong Neptune in a dual sign will argue both sides and convince you each way.
cells_derived_method: Neptune in a dual sign gives skill in arguing both sides. Strongest in Pisces and Gemini; house tells the area.

derived_examples.reading: Neptune in 3rd in Gemini: argues any side in talk and writing.
Neptune in 9th in Sagittarius: argues belief and disbelief with equal conviction.
Neptune in 12th in Pisces: argues for and against the spiritual path.

ambiguity: This follows the dual-sign claim for sign 12; he extends it to a general Neptune person.

hindi: वो आपको जरूर पागल कर देगा दही करके।
says: He will certainly drive you mad, turning your mind to curd.
cells_derived_method: Neptune in a dual sign makes others confused. House shows who is confused.

derived_examples.reading: Neptune in 7th in Pisces: partner leaves you in confusion.
Neptune in 11th in Gemini: friends overwhelm you with contradictions.

ambiguity: Idiomatic ('दही करके' means to churn into a mess).

hindi: ये तत्व राशियों के और ग्रहों की राशि के स्वभाव फायर, एयर, अर्थ, वाटर यह समझना इसलिए जरूरी है क्योंकि उसी अनुसार आपकी कुंडली में वरुण फल देगा।
says: Knowing the element nature of signs (fire, air, earth, water) is important, because Neptune gives results according to that in your chart.
cells_derived_method: Neptune's result is the product of the sign's element and modality with the house topic.

derived_examples.reading: Neptune in 4th in Aries (fire): domestic restlessness, quick changes of home.
Neptune in 2nd in Gemini (air): money through talk, with confusion about amounts.
Neptune in 10th in Taurus (earth): slow, material career with doubt behind it.

classical_check: Agrees in principle with classical sign-based reading of planets.

hindi: वरुण के पास सारे इललीगल ड्रग्स हैं।
says: All illegal drugs are Neptune's.
classical_check: Silent: classically intoxicants are Rahu or Saturn.

hindi: इसके पास सारी दवाइयां हैं।
says: All medicines are Neptune's too, so poison and medicine both come under it.
classical_check: Differs: classically Sun, Jupiter and Mercury.

hindi: इसके पास सारे के सारे वीड जो लोग अल्कोहल लेते हैं, दारूबाज होते हैं, अय्याश होते हैं।
says: Neptune owns weed, and the people who take alcohol, the heavy drinkers and the debauched.

gist: Says all of these belong to Neptune.

hindi: लिव इन रिलेशनशिप्स इसके पास है।
says: Live-in relationships are Neptune's domain.
cells_derived_method: In the 7th house Neptune gives live-in or unofficial bonds.

derived_examples.reading: Neptune in 7th in Aquarius: open or live-in union.
Neptune in 7th in Libra: a partnership without formal ties.

ambiguity: House 7 inferred from the topic.

hindi: सेक्सुअल एनकाउंटर्स इसके पास है।
says: Casual sexual encounters are Neptune's domain.

hindi: बर्थ कंट्रोल पिल इसके पास है।
says: Birth-control pills are under Neptune.
ambiguity: Medical item recorded as his claim only.

hindi: इसके पास संतान उपलब्धि का कार्यक्रम है।
says: Neptune also holds the programme of obtaining children, such as IVF or assisted conception.
cells_derived_method: 5th house is children; Neptune there can give children by assisted means.

derived_examples.reading: Neptune in 5th in Cancer: children through assisted or adopted routes.
Neptune in 5th in Pisces: children come after fertility treatment or prayer.

ambiguity: 'संतान उपलब्धि का कार्यक्रम' is read as assisted conception; he may mean any programme for getting a child.

hindi: इसी के पास आपके खजाना है।
says: Your treasure also lies with Neptune; hidden wealth is its domain.
classical_check: Silent: classical hidden treasure is the 8th house and Ketu.

hindi: इसी के पास एलन मस्क बनने की शक्ति है।
says: Neptune holds the power to make one a tycoon like Elon Musk, an extreme of wealth and vision.
ambiguity: A figurative example, not a chart rule.

gist: Political example about Modi's fortune.
Political example about Pakistan's loss.

hindi: यह कुछ भी कर सकता है।
says: Neptune can do anything; its power has no ceiling.

hindi: ये कृपा का देवता है।
says: Neptune is the god of grace.

hindi: इससे ऊपर कुछ नहीं चाहिए हमें।
says: We need nothing beyond it; Neptune's grace is sufficient.

hindi: ये सबसे ऊंची ताकत रखता है।
says: It holds the highest power of all the planets.
ambiguity: Contrasts with classical order where the Sun is the king.
classical_check: Differs: classical texts place the Sun as the strongest planet.

gist: Yes, sir (audience exchange).

hindi: ये जो स्थिर है।
says: The fixed signs are the point in question now.
cells_derived_method: none: introduces the fixed-sign use for starting work.
ambiguity: Fragment.

gist: Short yes from the audience.

hindi: तो पांच आठ 11 ये ऑफिस जॉइनिंग स्टार्टिंग करनी है न्यू ऑफिस में जॉइनिंग करनी है इस पे भी निर्भर करता है 100% बोले इतने बजे अंदर घुसियो ऑफिस में टिक जाइयो कुर्सी पे तेरे को ऑफिस से निकाल नहीं सकता कोई
says: For joining a new office, use fixed lagna (5, 8, 11): enter at a stated time, settle in the chair and nobody can remove you from the office.
cells_derived_method: Fixed lagna is used for joining a job so that the position holds. The cell is the lagna of the moment (muhurta ascendant, house 1) and not a planet's position.

derived_examples.reading: Joining in Leo lagna: a dignified, firm hold on the post.
Joining in Scorpio lagna: a strong, guarded hold.
Joining in Aquarius lagna: a stable position with a detached manner.

ambiguity: He names 5, 8 and 11 (Leo, Scorpio, Aquarius); sign 2 (Taurus) is left out of the spoken list but is also fixed.
classical_check: Agrees partly: muhurta texts advise fixed lagna for taking office.

hindi: कमाल कर देता है ये इतना सूक्ष्म है कि बड़ी-बड़ी चीजों में लोग देखते हैं तो बड़े काम असफल नहीं होते
says: Lagna choice does wonders and is so subtle that people who apply it in big undertakings find that big works do not fail.
cells_derived_method: none: general claim for muhurta lagna.
ambiguity: Garbled run-on; the claim is that lagna timing protects big projects.
classical_check: Agrees in spirit with classical muhurta; the 'no failure' claim is stronger than the texts.

hindi: पहले पत्थर की नीव रखी जाती है वो रखी जाती है स्थिर लगन में
says: The foundation stone is laid in a fixed lagna, so the building stays firm.
cells_derived_method: Foundation stone in fixed lagna. The cell is the lagna of the moment (muhurta ascendant, house 1) and not a planet's position.

derived_examples.reading: Foundation in Taurus lagna: a solid, lasting building.
Foundation in Leo lagna: a stately building that holds.
Foundation in Aquarius lagna: a stable structure with long use.

classical_check: Agrees: fixed lagna is recommended for foundation stones.

hindi: पहली ईंट तोड़ी जाती है पुरानी बिल्डिंग की यह चर में
says: The first brick of an old building is broken (demolition starts) in a movable lagna, so the old structure goes away and moves on.
cells_derived_method: Demolition in movable lagna. The cell is the lagna of the moment (muhurta ascendant, house 1) and not a planet's position.

derived_examples.reading: Demolition in Aries lagna: swift removal.
Demolition in Capricorn lagna: methodical removal.
Demolition in Libra lagna: orderly removal and replacement.

classical_check: Silent in common texts; sensible by the logic of movable and fixed lagna.

gist: Tail of the previous sentence: the first brick of the old building is broken.

hindi: द्व स्वभाव में करना ज्योतिषी के ज्ञान और नॉलेज के ऊपर है।
says: Starting something in a dual lagna depends on the astrologer's own knowledge; it is the hardest case to time well.
cells_derived_method: Dual lagna needs finer judgement (element, work type) than movable or fixed lagna. The cell is the lagna of the moment (muhurta ascendant, house 1) and not a planet's position.

derived_examples.reading: Start in Gemini lagna: air, so work is talk-based and the start needs care on scatter.
Start in Sagittarius lagna: fire, so the work runs with zeal but needs checks on overreach.
Start in Pisces lagna: water, so the work starts vaguely and needs a clear anchor.

classical_check: Agrees partly: dual lagna is mixed in classical muhurta.

hindi: अन्यथा काम थोड़ा चलता है।
says: Otherwise (without that skill) the work runs for a while in a dual lagna.
cells_derived_method: Work begun in a dual lagna runs in bursts. The cell is the lagna of the moment (muhurta ascendant, house 1) and not a planet's position.

derived_examples.reading: Start in Virgo lagna: steady in detail, with intermittent pauses.
Start in Gemini lagna: bursts of activity and drift.

gist: Says it stops a little.
Says it goes a little and stops a little.

hindi: तो दो स्वभाव में कोई बिजनेस या कारोबार शुरू किया जाए उसमें उथल-पुथल रहेगी।
says: A business started in a dual-nature lagna will see ups and downs, turmoil all along.
cells_derived_method: Business launch in a dual lagna gives an unsteady course. The cell is the lagna of the moment (muhurta ascendant, house 1) and not a planet's position.

derived_examples.reading: Launch in Gemini lagna: swings from changeable customers and ideas.
Launch in Virgo lagna: swings from detail problems and service disputes.
Launch in Pisces lagna: swings from unclear aims and funds.

classical_check: Agrees in spirit: dual lagnas are less steady.

gist: Says 'it will remain'.
Says the turmoil will keep going.
Says it is happening, stopping, going and not going.

hindi: उसके अंदर फिर डेप्थ में जाओगे तो ये चार कार्यक्रम चलेगा कि आपका फायर साइन फिर काम है किस प्रकार का
says: Going deeper, you must also check the element of the sign (fire, earth, air, water) and the kind of work, on top of movable, fixed or dual.
cells_derived_method: Result = modality x element x type of work: e.g., a movable fire lagna suits bold starts, a fixed earth lagna suits long builds.

derived_examples.reading: Start in Aries lagna (movable fire): bold, quick work.
Start in Virgo lagna (dual earth): detailed service work.
Start in Scorpio lagna (fixed water): deep, guarded long-term work.

ambiguity: 'ये चार कार्यक्रम' is garbled; read as the four elements applied on top of modality.
classical_check: Agrees: classical muhurta also checks the element of the lagna.

hindi: आपका काम की भी स्थिति ऐसी है जैसे वरुण अब चार आठ 12 का हो गया।
says: Work then behaves as Neptune does in the water signs 4, 8 and 12 (Cancer, Scorpio, Pisces).
cells_derived_method: Neptune in the water signs shows scale and swing in the house topic.

derived_examples.reading: Neptune in 10th in Cancer: career moves with moods and the public.
Neptune in 10th in Scorpio: a deep, guarded career.
Neptune in 10th in Pisces: career dissolves into causes or arts.

ambiguity: Garbled link: unclear whether he describes a muhurta lagna or Neptune's natal sign; read as Neptune's sign.

hindi: समुद्र को बांध भी दिया इसने और समुद्र जैसा बंधा हुआ भी चलना बहुत अच्छा भाई।
says: It has also bound the sea, and moving as the sea does while bound (held within limits) is very good.
cells_derived_method: A bound sea is Neptune in a fixed water sign (Scorpio): power with limits is the good form.

derived_examples.reading: Neptune in 8th in Scorpio: contained depth with strong insight.
Neptune in 5th in Scorpio: controlled intensity in creativity.

ambiguity: Garbled; the 'bound sea' is taken to be the fixed sign Scorpio from the next rows.

hindi: पता लगा दान करने पे आया।
says: A Neptune person, once he turns to giving, gives without any check.
cells_derived_method: Charity and wealth are the 2nd and 12th; Neptune there makes giving without limit.

derived_examples.reading: Neptune in 2nd in Pisces: gives away family wealth.
Neptune in 12th in Cancer: donates from the heart beyond means.

ambiguity: Houses 2 and 12 are inferred from wealth and expense.
classical_check: Agrees partly: the 12th is the house of expenditure and giving.

hindi: इतना किया कि खुद कंगले हो गए।
says: He gave so much that he himself became a pauper.
cells_derived_method: Neptune in the 2nd or 12th makes giving that ends in personal poverty.

derived_examples.reading: Neptune in 2nd in Taurus: savings drained by gifts.
Neptune in 12th in Sagittarius: religious donations beyond means.

hindi: कर्ण बन गए।
says: He became like Karna, the epic example of boundless charity.
cells_derived_method: Karna is an image for Neptune's boundless donor nature.
classical_check: Agrees partly: Karna is the classical example of boundless daana.

hindi: तो ये लिमिटेशन की अकल भी तो चाहिए।
says: So one also needs the sense of limitation to hold Neptune's giving in check.

hindi: प्यार किया ऐसे प्यार किया।
says: A Neptune lover loves in an extreme way.
cells_derived_method: Love is the 5th and 7th; Neptune there gives total, all-or-nothing love.

derived_examples.reading: Neptune in 5th in Pisces: romantic, self-sacrificing love.
Neptune in 7th in Scorpio: obsessive love.
Neptune in 5th in Aries: reckless, headlong love.

ambiguity: Houses 5 and 7 are inferred from the love topic.

hindi: टूट के प्यार किया।
says: He loved to the point of breaking down: love with total surrender.
cells_derived_method: Neptune in the 5th or 7th gives surrender in love.

derived_examples.reading: Neptune in 7th in Cancer: devoted, clinging love.
Neptune in 5th in Scorpio: intense surrender in romance.

hindi: मां-बाप को भी कह दिया तुम नहीं करोगे तो मैं तो मर जाऊंगा या मर जाऊंगी।
says: He told even his parents: if you do not agree I will die; Neptune love makes ultimatums. (His illustration, not a prediction.)
cells_derived_method: Neptune in 5th or 7th makes dramatic threats in love matters.

derived_examples.reading: Neptune in 7th in Pisces: theatrical ultimatums to family over a partner.

ambiguity: Recorded only as his illustration; no claim about self-harm outcomes.

hindi: और फिर तलाक किया तो इतने जोर शोर से किया कि पूरे मोहल्ले को पता लग गया कि भैया मोहल्ला देश को पता चल गया।
says: When such a person divorces it is so loud that the neighbourhood and then the country come to know.
cells_derived_method: 7th house with Neptune: break-ups become public and magnified.

derived_examples.reading: Neptune in 7th in Leo: a dramatic public divorce.
Neptune in 7th in Gemini: a divorce that spreads through gossip and media.

ambiguity: Exaggerated for effect.

hindi: मर्डर हुआ तो ऐसा हुआ कि पूरे विश्व को फैल गई बात।
says: If a murder happens in a Neptune matter, the news spreads to the entire world. (Recorded as his illustration only.)
cells_derived_method: none: planet nature, scale of Neptune events.
ambiguity: Hyperbole; not a prediction.

hindi: ये जो करेगा बहुत बड़ा करेगा।
says: Whatever Neptune does it does on a big scale.

hindi: आपको बढ़ाएगा तो बहुत बड़ा इंसान बनाएगा।
says: If Neptune lifts you, it makes you a very great person.

hindi: झगड़े कराएगा तो बहुत ज्यादा बड़े झगड़े कराएगा।
says: If it brings quarrels, they will be very large quarrels (continues 'आपके' from the previous chunk).

gist: Rhetorical question: when will this (positive side) happen?

hindi: जब अर्जुन छोड़ देगा कृष्ण पे खोपड़ी का काम।
says: It happens when, like Arjuna, you leave the brain work (worry and planning) to Krishna.
classical_check: Agrees with the Bhagavad Gita theme of surrender.

gist: Quotes the surrender line: I will not think.

hindi: जो केतु है वो भी आपको स्पिरिचुअल बनाता है लेकिन वो आपकी सोच और क्षमता के अनुसार पांच सेंसेस के बाहर दिखाता है समझाता है
says: Ketu also makes you spiritual, but it shows and explains what lies beyond the five senses only within the limit of your thinking and capacity.
classical_check: Agrees: Ketu is the classical moksha karaka.

hindi: ये सोच समझ के क्षमता खत्म एनलाइटनमेंट शब्द जो चलता है वो वरुण के पास है
says: Where thinking capacity ends, enlightenment, as the word is used, belongs to Neptune.
classical_check: Differs: classical enlightenment (moksha) is Ketu and Jupiter.

gist: Rhetorical question: have you understood this?

hindi: ये धर्म के ड्रामे भी ड्रामे हैं
says: The conflicts between religions are also dramas; Neptune sees them as theatre.

gist: One religion says eat meat without problem, another says it is a sin.
Heaven and hell: heaven or jannat is claimed even for meat eaters, elsewhere never.
Rhetorical question: how is this?
Rhetorical question: what is this drama of religions?

hindi: ये वरुण समझाता है।
says: Neptune is the planet that explains the contradictions of religions.

gist: Says if you understood this, it will get into your head.

hindi: इसकी दृष्टि हजार दृष्टि है।
says: Its aspect is a thousand-fold aspect, meaning it sees across the whole chart with many eyes.
cells_derived_method: Planet's aspect reaches every house of the chart, not only the 7th.

hindi: ब्रेन की स्पीड स्लो रखनी है। सात से 14 हर्ट्ज आपके पास प्रकट हो के चीज आएगी। आराम से करना है।
