hindi: इसका कोई नुक्ता है तो बताओ। इसका नुक्ता ईश्वर को साथ ले चलो। बिना कृष्ण के कहीं जाना ही नहीं है। अपना कृष्ण खुद चुनो।
says: The trick for Neptune is to take God along everywhere, never going anywhere without Krishna, and choose your own Krishna (your own chosen deity).

gist: Casual talk: let delays happen, someone may get annoyed, it is their wish; I stay in my own joy and this must be kept going.
Remark that people become self-conscious and panic over a small debt of 500 rupees taken from someone.
Says a favour has a price that must be paid, as a lead-in to the question about intuition.
Banter line 'brother, it is all yours until it is mine' with an audience member.

hindi: सर अगर किसी को इंट्यूशन पावर थोड़ी बहुत होती थोड़ी बहुत नहीं होती जी इंट्यूशन पावर सबको होती है हमें इस्तेमाल करनी नहीं आती
says: Answering a student: intuition is not a gift of a few people; everyone has intuition power, but most of us have not learned how to use it.
ambiguity: Not tied to a planet here; in the previous chunk intuition was linked to Neptune and the 9th house.
classical_check: Silent; classical texts tie intuition to the 5th, 9th and Moon, not to a universal faculty.

gist: Story begins: there was a king of such large heart that he lived lovingly with everyone (a person should have such joy).
The king had a servant named Mangeram whom he kept always with him and loved all the time.
Mangeram cared for the king more than a real son would and used to say 'you are my father and my God'.
The king let Mangeram sleep in his own chamber while the commander stayed outside, showing how close the two were.
Once the king went hunting and took Mangeram along on the horse.
The king stopped the commander and army far away, went deep into the forest, lost the way and became hungry.
The king complained of trouble; Mangeram offered to arrange food and pointed to fruit on the tree above.
Mangeram stood on the horse, climbed the tree, plucked a fruit and brought it to the king.
The king peeled the fruit with his knife and said he would give the first piece to Mangeram as a poison check.
Mangeram insisted he would eat first; the king cut a small piece and Mangeram ate it.
The king asked how it tasted; Mangeram said extremely delicious and asked for another piece.
The king gently teased him as childish, gave another piece, and Mangeram ate that too.
Mangeram asked again and asked for a bigger slice each time.
The king asked what would be left for him; Mangeram kept taking segments, third, fourth, fifth, until little was left.
Only one segment was left; the king said he should be ashamed for not letting the master who treats him as God and father eat.
The king begged for the last piece, touching his feet; Mangeram flatly refused and said he would eat it himself.
Mangeram snatched it away; the king threatened to have him killed for insolence and Mangeram said he was ready to die but would still eat it.
The king gave a royal order to return it; Mangeram folded his hands, asked him to think again, and the king insisted.
The king put the piece in his mouth, found it poisonously bitter and spat it out.
The king asked why Mangeram had made him jealous and angry and had not said at the first piece that it was poison.
Mangeram replied that he had eaten delicious fruits from the king's hands all his life, so how could he complain about one bitter one.
The king embraced him and declared Mangeram would be his successor.

hindi: ऐसे वरुण कृपा देता है अगर उसकी दी हुई कष्टों को हम गले लगा ले जीवन में।
says: The moral: Neptune (Varuna) gives grace in this way, if we accept and embrace the hardships it gives in life instead of resisting them.
classical_check: Silent; acceptance-of-karma is a common tradition teaching, not a rule.

hindi: भगवान ने हमें हजारों लाखों करोड़ों सुख दिए हैं।
says: God has already given each of us thousands, lakhs and crores of pleasures, which is the basis for tolerating one bitter fruit from Neptune.

hindi: और हम जरा सा दुख आते ही कुत्ते की तरह मिमियाने या भौकने लगते हैं उसके ऊपर। सड़ने कुड़ने लगते हैं।
says: At the first small sorrow we whine and bark at God like a dog and fume and rot inside; this complaining blocks the grace he is describing.

hindi: भाई ने मुझे जीवन भर पालापसा प्यार दिया। मां ने किया, बहन ने किया। थोड़ा सा ठग लिया। कोई बात नहीं।
says: Example of the right attitude to the 3rd-house betrayal: the brother gave love all your life, and mother and sister did too; if he cheated you a little once, let it go.
ambiguity: Links back to the Neptune-in-3rd sibling deception stated in the previous batch.

hindi: वहां से कृपा मिलेगी अगर छोड़ दिया माफ करो
says: Remedy: forgive and let go of the wrong done to you; grace then comes from the very place where you were hurt.
classical_check: Silent; forgiveness as remedy is not a classical rule.

hindi: किसी सहेली के साथ मित्र के साथ बहुत सुंदर समय हुआ 20 बार फोन पर अच्छी बात हुई दो बार बुरी हुई अब आपको नफरत हो गई
says: Example: with a friend you had 20 good phone talks and 2 bad ones, and now you hate them; he is pointing at how we let two bad events erase many good ones.

hindi: इतनी सुंदर बातें जिसने आपको दी उससे दो बार के लड़ाई के अंदर आपने उससे नफरत कर डाली उसे माफ नहीं कर सकते आप पर कृपा की कमी रहेगी
says: If you hate someone who gave you so many good things because of two quarrels, and cannot forgive, you will lack grace.
ambiguity: Reads as a moral rule linked to Neptune's grace, not a chart-based rule.

hindi: कृपा लेने वाले वो होते हैं जो कहते हैं अरे एक आध कड़वा फल ही सही ये वरुण की कृपा लेना सीखो
says: People who receive grace are those who say 'so what if one fruit is bitter'; learn to receive Neptune's grace with that attitude.

hindi: हम सब भिखारी हैं ज्योति बने ना बने कृपा लेना तो सीखो हमसे माफ ही
says: We are all beggars before the divine; whether or not you become an astrologer, learn to receive grace; he admits that we find it hard to forgive.
ambiguity: 'ज्योति' is likely 'ज्योतिषी' (astrologer); the sentence is cut at the chunk edge.

hindi: नहीं होता तो इसलिए कड़वा फल अगर भगवान दे रहा है बुरे दिन दे रहा है
says: So if God is giving a bitter fruit, meaning bad days, accept it as part of the grace process; he completes the thought 'we cannot forgive' with this advice.
ambiguity: Sentence begins at the chunk edge ('हमसे माफ ही नहीं होता').

gist: Young people come to him crying that they lost their job; he tells them to wait two months.

hindi: और जो तू 2 साल से कर रहा था उसका कोई थैंक्स नहीं क्या हो गया 2 महीने जॉब नहीं है ये हमें सहन ही नहीं होता
says: We show no thanks for two years of earning; when a job is missing for two months we cannot bear it; this intolerance is why Neptune's grace does not reach us.
ambiguity: A job-loss example, not investment or career prediction.

gist: Mock dialogue of a youngster saying he will die, with the point that for years he had no job and now two months without it is called death.
Examples of tolerating a child's rude word after 20 years of worship, or a father slapping once; asks what has actually happened.

hindi: वरुण कृपा ही तब देगा।
says: Neptune will give its grace only when we accept the bitter along with the sweet; acceptance is the condition for grace.

hindi: नहीं तो वरुण नर्क भी देता है और पार्टी भी देता है। अन्यथा नहीं देगा।
says: Otherwise Neptune can give hell as well as parties; its results swing to both extremes, and without the right attitude it will not give grace.

hindi: पहले भाव का वरुण एक नंबर राशि का वरुण है ये। यानी आप मंगल की राशि भी ले चल सकते हो और मंगल का स्थान भी।
says: Neptune in the 1st house is like Neptune in sign number 1 (Aries), because the 1st house and Aries both belong to Mars; you can take Mars's sign as well as Mars's place.
cells_derived_method: House 1 and sign Aries are tied together through Mars (natural lord of both). The same rule would give house 2 and Taurus to Venus, 3 and Gemini to Mercury, and so on around the zodiac, so Neptune's result in each house borrows the character of the matching sign lord.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: by the same house-sign equivalence, Neptune in the 2nd in Taurus (lagna Aries) would borrow Venus's flavour, in speech, family and money.
Derived: Neptune in the 4th in Cancer (lagna Aries) matches the 4th house equals Cancer, Moon's pairing, so home, mother and emotions colour the Neptune result.
Derived: Neptune in the 7th in Libra (lagna Aries) links the 7th house and Libra, both Venus-ruled, so partnership glamour and illusion.

ambiguity: 'एक नंबर' could mean house number 1 or sign number 1; he uses both and says they coincide.
classical_check: Agrees with the Kalapurusha idea (house n as natural sign n) used in classical texts; Neptune is his addition.

hindi: जैसे साउथ ईस्ट में आपके किचन होनी चाहिए। यह मान के हम चलते हैं।
says: Vastu analogy: by rule the kitchen should be in the south-east, the fire corner, and we take that as the accepted rule.
ambiguity: Vastu rule stated as an analogy, not tied to a house number here.
classical_check: Agrees with standard vastu: the kitchen belongs in the south-east (Agni corner).

hindi: तो वो किचन का इलाका कहां निर्धारित है? साउथ ईस्ट। लेकिन हो सकता है नॉर्थ में हो, वेस्ट में हो, ईस्ट में हो।
says: The kitchen's assigned zone is the south-east, but the actual kitchen in a house may stand in the north, west or east; the assigned place and the actual place can differ.
ambiguity: Used as a model for a planet whose natural place differs from where it sits.

hindi: यानी कि एक नंबर का भाव जो है यह मंगल
says: By the same analogy, the 1st house is Mars's assigned place (its natural house).
ambiguity: Sentence is cut at the chunk edge and finished in the next row.
classical_check: Agrees: Mars is the natural significator of the 1st house in Kalapurusha reading (Aries).

hindi: का है। लेकिन हो सकता है मंगल एक नंबर का यहां बैठा हो। लेकिन एक्चुअली स्थान उसका यहां है। इस प्रकार से होता है।
says: Mars may be sitting in some other house, but its actual home place is the 1st; so a planet's natural place and its placement in a chart are two different things.
cells_derived_method: The principle applies to every planet: a planet's natural house (its Kalapurusha place) and its chart house differ, so rules should be checked on both.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mars in the 6th in Capricorn (lagna Leo) sits away from its natural 1st-house place, yet is exalted in sign.
Derived: Mars in the 12th in Scorpio (lagna Sagittarius) is in its own sign but in a house far from its natural place.

classical_check: Agrees in method: karaka house versus bhava placement is classical.

hindi: तो एक नंबर का मंगल ये चर राशि है और अग्नि स्थान अग्नि है। अग्नि तत्व है। फायर अर्थ एयर वाटर।
says: Sign number 1 (Aries, Mars's sign) is a movable (chara) sign, and it is a fire sign; he recites the element order fire, earth, air, water as the sequence of signs.
cells_derived_method: The element repeats Aries fire, Taurus earth, Gemini air, Cancer water, then again through the zodiac; the modality sequence is movable, fixed, dual.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Cancer is the fourth in the element order, so water, and is also movable.
Derived: Libra is seventh, so air, also movable (lagna Aries).

classical_check: Agrees: Aries is a fiery, movable sign.

hindi: तो यहां पर क्या होगा? आग है। आग का साइन और इसमें क्या आ गया? वरुण पानी जल देवता नॉट गुड।
says: Neptune in the fire sign Aries (house 1) is not good, because Neptune is a water god placed in a sign of fire.
cells_derived_method: The water-in-fire conflict applies to Neptune in any fire sign (Aries, Leo, Sagittarius); in water signs the same planet is comfortable; in the 5th or 9th houses the conflict is moderated by trine support.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Neptune in the 5th in Aries (lagna Sagittarius), the fire conflict touches creativity and children.
Derived: Neptune in the 10th in Leo (lagna Scorpio), water in fire in the career house; image-building and ego clash.
Derived: Neptune in the 1st in Cancer (lagna Cancer), water in water, no such conflict; contrast case.

ambiguity: Neptune is called 'not good' here; no scale of badness is given.
classical_check: Silent on Neptune; element-friction logic is his own.

hindi: तो क्या करेगा यहां आग पानी को बुझा देगी नहीं तो पानी आग को गर्म कर देगा तो क्या स्थिति बनेगी
says: In fire with water, either the fire evaporates the water or the water cools the fire; he asks what situation results, setting up the conflict.
ambiguity: 'गर्म कर देगा' (water will heat the fire) is odd; likely a caption slip for 'put out the fire'.

hindi: एक नंबर राशि मंगल हनुमान जी ये समुद्र को पार कर जाते हैं यहां कहानियां काम आती है यानी कि एक नंबर को नष्ट नहीं कर सकता
says: Aries and Mars correspond to Hanuman, who crosses the sea; the story helps here: water (Neptune) cannot destroy the 1st house or Aries, since Mars leaps over it.
ambiguity: A mythic argument rather than a measured rule.
classical_check: Silent; Hanuman as a Mars deity is a tradition view.

hindi: तो क्या होगा मंगल क्या है युद्ध युद्ध का देवता है ऐसे व्यक्ति युद्ध करेंगे युद्धपोत का काम करेंगे टॉर्पिडोस का काम करेंगे जितने भी उद्यम है लड़ाई भिड़ाई
says: Mars is the god of war, so a person with Neptune in the 1st and Aries will fight, act like a warship or torpedo, and take up ventures involving fighting and clashes.
cells_derived_method: The warrior expression comes from Mars's sign and house with Neptune's sea imagery; in Scorpio (Mars's other sign) a hidden naval or underwater version; in the 1st house in other signs the fighting is toned down by the sign's planet.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Neptune in the 1st in Scorpio (lagna Scorpio), Mars's other sign, a submarine-like hidden fighter.
Derived: Neptune in the 1st in Pisces (lagna Pisces), Jupiter's water sign; far less war-like, more dreamy.

ambiguity: 'युद्धपोत' (warship) and 'टॉर्पिडो' are images, not literal careers.

hindi: मंगल के पास क्या है फार्मेसी डॉक्टरी कार्यक्रम चीरफाड़ काटने वाली चीजें चाकू छुरी
says: Mars governs pharmacy, medical practice and surgery, and everything that cuts, such as knives.
ambiguity: 'कार्यक्रम' appears garbled; likely 'ऑपरेशन' or 'प्रोग्राम'.
classical_check: Agrees: Mars is karaka of surgery, knives and cutting instruments.

hindi: ऐसे लोग चाकू छुरी लेकर के गंदगी मचाते हैं।
says: Such people (Neptune in Mars's place) can create a mess with knives, meaning violent or reckless medical or cutting work.
ambiguity: Could be general behaviour or a medical-profession statement; he does not say which.

hindi: लग्न में बैठा हुआ यदि आपका नेप्च्यून है राशि कोई भी हो एक नंबर नहीं राशि कोई भी हो लेकिन
says: If Neptune sits in the lagna in any sign, not only in Aries, a particular result follows; he begins the generalisation here but the result is cut off.
cells_derived_method: Neptune in the 1st house in any sign shows the person's personality as dreamy, vague and imaginative; the sign sets the style: fire sign restless, earth sign materialist, air sign talkative, water sign emotional.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Neptune in the 1st in Taurus (lagna Taurus), Venus's sign where Neptune is friendly; a sensual, artistic personality.
Derived: Neptune in the 1st in Virgo (lagna Virgo), earth sign with Mercury, whose sharp analysis fights Neptune's vagueness.
Derived: Neptune in the 1st in Aquarius (lagna Aquarius), air sign, a visionary or eccentric personality.

ambiguity: The sentence ends mid-thought ('लेकिन'), so the result is unknown; the derived readings use general Neptune qualities he gave earlier.

hindi: इस भाव की स्पेशलिटी है कि फायर स्थान फायर फायर है यहां और चर चर है।
says: The special feature of this combination (1st house with Aries) is that both the place and the sign are fire, and both are movable (chara); so the first house and Aries double up in element and in modality.
cells_derived_method: Other house-sign pairs where the house's natural sign (house n = sign n) matches the sign give the same doubling: 5th with Leo (fire, fixed), 9th with Sagittarius (fire, dual), 4th with Cancer (water, movable). Where house and sign differ, the two characters mix instead of doubling.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: 5th house in Leo (lagna Aries) doubles fire but with fixed modality.
Derived: 9th house in Sagittarius (lagna Aries) doubles fire with dual modality.
Derived: 4th house in Cancer (lagna Aries) doubles water with movable modality; contrast case to fire.

ambiguity: The 'house = sign number' matching is his Kalapurusha-style frame; a real chart can have the house in a different sign.
classical_check: Agrees: Aries is a fiery movable sign and the 1st house is its natural house in Kalapurusha reading.

hindi: ये ऐसे व्यक्ति हर हालत के अंदर अपने आप को आंकेंगे नहीं किसी औकात का।
says: A person with Neptune in the 1st house in Aries will not value himself in any situation; he will never rate his own worth.
cells_derived_method: The self-undervaluing comes from water meeting fire in the self house; in other signs of the 1st, it softens where the sign is water (Cancer, Scorpio, Pisces) because Neptune is at home, and strengthens in earth signs where Saturn or Venus dominate self-image.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Neptune in the 1st in Cancer (lagna Cancer); water in water, self-worth is shaky mostly through over-sensitivity.
Derived: Neptune in the 1st in Capricorn (lagna Capricorn); Saturn's discipline checks Neptune, self-worth is built through duty and work.

ambiguity: He says 'ऐसे व्यक्ति' about the Aries-lagna Neptune case; for other signs he only says later that the pattern also appears in any sign.

hindi: यानी जल जला हुआ जो अग्नि है वह अग्नि पानी में पहुंच गई या पानी अग्नि पर पहुंच गया तो ऐसी स्थिति के अंदर उसकी ताकत कम हो जाती है
says: When fire reaches water, or water reaches fire, the strength of the fire is reduced; so Neptune (water) in a fire place weakens the Mars-fire strength of the first house.
cells_derived_method: Element-clash weakening applies to fire signs only (Aries, Leo, Sagittarius) and to the fire houses (1st, 5th, 9th) if his house-sign equivalence is used; in water or earth placements there is no clash.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Neptune in the 5th in Aries (lagna Sagittarius), water in a fire house and fire sign, double clash weakening creative drive.
Derived: Neptune in the 9th in Sagittarius (lagna Aries), clash of water with fire in belief and higher learning.

ambiguity: 'जल जला' is garbled; the meaning 'burning fire' is read from context.
classical_check: Silent; element-clash arguments are his own.

hindi: तो ऐसे लोग अपनी वर्थ नहीं मानते उनके जीवन में भयंकर नशे की लत आ सकती है
says: Such people do not accept their own worth, and a terrible addiction to intoxicants can enter their life; this is a tendency claim recorded as his tradition view.
cells_derived_method: Neptune is the karaka of intoxicants; its placement in the self-house with low self-worth feeds the addiction pathway. In other signs the addiction type changes: air signs favour smoking, water signs alcohol, earth signs food or sugar.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Neptune in the 1st in Pisces (lagna Pisces), strongest escapist pull; alcohol or sedatives.
Derived: Neptune in the 1st in Gemini (lagna Gemini), air sign; more smoking-type or talk-driven habits.

ambiguity: A statement about addiction risk, not a medical diagnosis.

hindi: लेकिन किस स्थिति में आ सकती है या फिर दवाइयों की लत हो सकती है कि दवाई खा लूं रोज खाएंगे
says: The addiction may also be to medicines: a person keeps taking a medicine daily out of habit; this is Neptune's drug-karaka side in the first house.
ambiguity: Garbled beginning ('किस स्थिति में आ सकती है'); the second half is clear.

gist: Mock example of a patient who feels better and says he will keep taking steroids because Crocin once cured him.
Medical remark that people do not know why Crocin or paracetamol is taken for fever and that it can overload the liver (a health claim by him, not astrology; not endorsed here).

hindi: ऐसी स्थिति में व्यक्ति को अपनी औकात आंकी नहीं जाती। वो सोचता है मैं हूं ही किस लायक। मैं तो किसी लायक ही नहीं हूं।
says: In this condition the person cannot judge his own standing and thinks 'what am I worth, I am fit for nothing'; low self-esteem is the core of the pattern.

hindi: अगर ऐसा व्यक्ति मान लो डॉक्टर है क्योंकि वो अपनी औकात नहीं आंकता तो लोगों को क्या बोलता है? पैसे यार ₹100 दे दो। मुझे लगता
says: If such a person is a doctor, because he does not value himself he asks patients for only 100 rupees; a career-level result of the low self-worth.
ambiguity: Sentence continues into the next chunk; the doctor is an illustration, not a rule of profession.
classical_check: Silent; doctor work is Mars/Sun and fits his Mars-house link.

hindi: नहीं इससे ऊपर कोई मुझे देगा। इससे ऊपर मेरी औकात नहीं है। वो मांग नहीं सकेगा ज्यादा पैसा। वो अपने आप को ऊंचा नहीं मानता।
says: He feels nobody will pay more than that, cannot ask for higher fees and does not consider himself high; so earning is capped by his own low self-image.

hindi: ऐसी स्थिति में पिट पिट करके सब लोग कहते हैं कहते हैं घर के लोग कई बच्चों को तू किसी लायक नहीं हूं। कहते हैं हां मैं किसी लायक नहीं हूं।
says: Household members repeatedly beat down such children, saying they are good for nothing, and the child accepts 'yes, I am worthless'.
ambiguity: 'पिट पिट करके' is repeated hits or constant nagging; 'beating' is read figuratively.

hindi: डिप्रेशन में जा सकते हैं।
says: They can slip into depression; he states it as a possible outcome of the pattern (a tendency claim, not a diagnosis).
ambiguity: Mental-health claim recorded only as his statement.

hindi: और ऐसे लोग अल्टीमेटली एनलाइटनमेंट की ओर जाते हैं। क्योंकि पिट-पिट करके धीरे-धीरे सांसारिकता से त्याग हो जाता है और धीरे-धीरे उनको डुअलिटी खत्म हो के एक आंख ही हो जाते हैं।
says: Ultimately such people move toward enlightenment: repeated knocks slowly detach them from worldliness and dissolve duality so that they see with one eye (non-dual vision).
ambiguity: 'एक आंख' means seeing everything as one (non-duality).
classical_check: Silent; classical texts link renunciation to Ketu, Saturn and 12th house.

hindi: या तो वो पागल हो जाते हैं या फिर वो एनलाइटेंड हो जाते हैं।
says: The result is split in two: either the person goes mad or becomes enlightened; he sees no middle outcome for strong cases (mental-health word used loosely, recorded as his claim).
ambiguity: 'पागल' is used loosely; not a clinical statement.

hindi: वो ये जान जाते हैं संसार में कुछ नहीं रखा। छोड़ो यार त्यागो क्या रखा है? ऐसी स्थिति में उनके मन के अंदर कोई चीज उन्हें ललायित करे पॉसिबल नहीं है।
says: They realise there is nothing in the world; at that stage nothing can tempt or attract their mind any more, which is the renunciate end of the pattern.

hindi: आप सोचिए कृपा का ग्रह कितना पावरफुल हो गया। लग्न में उसने ड्रग एडिक्ट बनाया, अल्कोहलिक बनाया और उसने ज्ञानी बना डाला इस चक्कर में।
says: The planet of grace is so powerful: Neptune in the lagna can make one a drug addict, an alcoholic, and then also a wise person within the same cycle.
cells_derived_method: The extreme range (addict to sage) is the Neptune-in-lagna signature; the sign sets which pole is more likely: Pisces, Cancer or Scorpio lean to the wisdom side, Aries, Leo or Libra more to indulgence in his scheme.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Neptune in the 1st in Pisces (lagna Pisces), tilted toward mystic or healer outcomes.
Derived: Neptune in the 1st in Libra (lagna Libra), where in his scheme Neptune co-rules Libra; luxury and indulgence are close.

hindi: तो आपकी एक यात्रा है। ये एक यात्रा चली। संसार को समझ नहीं पाए।
says: So the life is a journey: it began with addiction and confusion because the world was not understood, and it ends in wisdom.

hindi: आप दवाइयों की लत लेते हैं। ऐसी स्थिति में मॉर्फीन की लत देता है। मॉर्फीन होता है
says: With Neptune in the lagna this way you take on drug dependence; in such a state it gives addiction to morphine, a strong opioid drug.
ambiguity: Sentence continues into the next chunk ('पेन किलर').

hindi: पेन किलर। पेन किलर। आपको पेन होता है तो आपको लत लगा देगा मॉर्फीन की। अब मॉर्फीन की लत है मॉर्फीन की गोली खाना
says: Morphine is a painkiller; when there is pain, Neptune can hook the person to taking morphine tablets as a habit.
ambiguity: A claim about dependence risk; not medical advice.

hindi: या दूसरा फ्लिप साइड क्या हुई कि आप योग और साधना में चले जाते हैं और अपने ब्रेन को सुला देते हैं। आपको दर्द महसूस नहीं होता। दर्द सहने की गजब की क्षमता देता है।
says: The flip side: the person goes into yoga and sadhana, puts the brain to sleep, feels no pain and gets great capacity to tolerate pain.

hindi: भावना हीनता की भावना आती है। आत्मविश्वास की कमी आती है। खुद में सेल्फ नहीं है। कॉन्फिडेंस कॉन्फिडेंस नहीं होता ऐसे इंसान में।
says: Feelings of inferiority and a lack of self-confidence arise; there is no solid sense of self, so such a person lacks confidence.
ambiguity: 'भावना हीनता' is likely 'हीन भावना' (inferiority complex).

hindi: वर्चुअल रियलिटी की तकनीक वगैरह युद्ध का आदेश वर्चुअल तो वीडियो गेम्स के बहुत शौकीन होते हैं ऐसे लोग।
says: Virtual-reality technology belongs to Neptune, and people with this placement are very fond of video games.
ambiguity: 'युद्ध का आदेश' (war command) is garbled; probably refers to war-type games.

hindi: इसलिए घर में अगर बच्चा वीडियो गेम खेलने में लगा हुआ है तो उसे लड़ो मत भाई।
says: Advice to parents: if a child at home is hooked on video games, do not fight with him, since the habit is rooted in his chart.

hindi: और वो सारे लड़ाई वाले गेम खेलेगा। कहेंगे यार ढंग का खेल ले तू कैंडी क्रश खेल ले। वो कहेगा नहीं मैं तो शिप क्रश खेलूंगा। पूरी शिप तोड़ दूंगा क्योंकि समुद्र का देवता है।
says: Such a child will play fighting games; offered Candy Crush he would choose a ship-smashing game, because Neptune is the god of the sea and his Mars-fire wants to break ships.
ambiguity: Humorous dialogue; the claim is only the war-game and ship preference.

hindi: इसलिए शिप्स के लिए बहुत पसंदीदा होता है इनका हिसाब किताब।
says: Ships are very much a favourite subject for such people, linked to Neptune as lord of the sea.
ambiguity: 'हिसाब किताब' is loosely 'dealings'.
classical_check: Silent; ships are classically Moon, Venus and Mercury.

hindi: दूसरे घर का जो है ये दूसरे घर के अंदर अगर आपका वरुण प्लेस्ड है।
says: Next case introduced: Neptune placed inside the 2nd house; the following rows give the results.

hindi: अब ये मुन्ना भाई की कुंडली में यहां से यहां प्लेस्ड है। चाहे यहां से यहां अगर इस घर में कहीं भी कनेक्शन आ गया तो ये शुक्र का घर है दो नंबर।
says: In the Munna Bhai example chart the Neptune sits somewhere across this house's span; if Neptune connects anywhere inside the 2nd house, that is Venus's house (number 2), so the house is treated as a range, not a single point.
cells_derived_method: Since the house is read as a span covering parts of more than one sign, Neptune in the early part (Taurus-like, Venus) or later part (Gemini-like, Mercury) of the 2nd gives different shades; the same applies to each house.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Neptune in the 2nd in Taurus (lagna Aries) is fully in Venus's sign, strongest luxury and food-and-money link.
Derived: Neptune in the 2nd in Gemini (lagna Taurus); the Mercury part of the span, speech-driven wealth and talk of money.
Derived: Neptune in the 2nd in Scorpio (lagna Libra); hidden or inherited wealth and secret spending.

ambiguity: 'यहां से यहां' is pointing at a chart on screen; his span boundaries are not readable from the caption.
classical_check: Agrees with bhava-chalit thinking (houses span more than one sign); 2nd as Venus's natural house is Kalapurusha.

hindi: यानी क्या करेगा? विलासिता। चीजें होनी चाहिए
says: Neptune connected to the 2nd house gives a love of luxury; the person feels many things must be there in life.
ambiguity: Sentence continues into the next chunk.
classical_check: Silent; consistent with 2nd house as wealth and Venus as luxury.

hindi: खूब सारी यार। टशन वाली होगी। जो करूंगा बेस्ट करूंगा भाई। मेरे घर में फर्नीचर आएगा। सबसे महंगा पेंट करो इस पे। कोई टेंशन नहीं है।
says: The person wants many stylish things, the best of everything, the costliest furniture and paint for the house, and has no tension about spending.

hindi: पैसे तो देगा क्योंकि विलासिता है।
says: Neptune in the 2nd will also supply the money, because luxury is its theme; spending and income both come.
ambiguity: A wealth claim from the chart, not investment advice.

hindi: दो नंबर सात नंबर इकट्ठा होते हैं हृदय चक्र पे तो पैसे की कोई कमी नहीं है।
says: Number 2 and number 7 (both Venus's numbers) meet at the heart chakra; with this link there is no shortage of money.
cells_derived_method: Taurus (2) and Libra (7) are both Venus's signs, so wealth from the 2nd flows with the 7th house of business and partnership. Which sign the Neptune sits in decides whether the 2nd-7th axis is activated.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Neptune in the 2nd in Libra (lagna Virgo), Venus-ruled; the 2nd-7th wealth link is activated through the sign.
Derived: Neptune in the 7th in Taurus (lagna Scorpio), the 7th house of business with the sign of the 2nd; money from partners.

ambiguity: 'दो नंबर सात नंबर' may mean houses 2 and 7 or signs 2 and 7 (both Venus's); and the heart-chakra link is his own mapping.
classical_check: 2nd and 7th as maraka and money-related houses are classical; the chakra mapping is not.

hindi: ऐसी स्थिति में इसके जितने भी रिश्ते होंगे वो काम कभी नहीं आएंगे।
says: With Neptune in the 2nd, none of the person's own relationships will ever be of use to him in need.
ambiguity: The 2nd is the house of family, so 'रिश्ते' likely means blood relatives.
classical_check: Silent; 2nd is classical house of family.

hindi: समुद्र अपने काम नहीं आता। यहां के व्यक्ति अपने काम नहीं आता औरों के आता है। स्पिरिचुअल हो गया।
says: The sea is not useful to itself; likewise such a person is not useful to himself but to others, which makes him spiritual.

gist: Repeats that the relationships of a person with Neptune in the 2nd do not help him.

hindi: इस पर बहुत धन होता है हर समय। लेकिन इसको लगता है पैसे आए ही नहीं। पैसे हैं कहां?
says: Such a person always holds plenty of money, yet he feels that no money has come and keeps asking where the money is; the sense of lack persists despite wealth.

hindi: तो ऐसी स्थिति में हो सकता है ये पागलपन में और पैसों में लगा रहे।
says: In this state he may stay absorbed in madness and money together, running after wealth in a wild way.
ambiguity: 'पागलपन' used loosely.

hindi: ऐसे लोग वो होते हैं जिनको आईडिया मिलता है। भाई ये वाला बिज़नेस करते हैं। ये वाला बिजनेस करते हैं हम। भाई नया स्टार्टअप करेंगे।
says: Such people are those who keep getting ideas: one business after another, a new startup; Neptune in the 2nd produces endless business ideas.

gist: Mimics tall talk: heaps of notes will pile up, I am telling you, buy this share (mocking talk, not an investment recommendation).

hindi: सारे टाइम नए-नए हवा फोके आईडिया जो एकिस्ट नहीं करते। समुद्र का अंत एक्सिस्ट नहीं करता।
says: They always carry new airy ideas that do not exist in reality, just as the sea has no end; the ideas never close.

hindi: इस तरह यहां ऐसी-ऐसी बातें होंगी कि अंत नहीं है कोई बातों का। चले हुए पागलोंपन की बस लगे हुए बातें हो रही है। लंबी-लंबी छोड़ रहे हैं। करना धरना कुछ नहीं।
says: Endless talk with no end, tall claims and mad plans, but nothing actually done; talking replaces doing in this placement.
ambiguity: The last sentence 'करना धरना कुछ नहीं' falls just past the next timestamp; kept here with its thought.

hindi: अगर तो ये व्यक्ति ऐसा संतुष्ट हुआ अच्छी राशि का नेप्च्यून यहां पर मूवमेंट दे रहा है तो वो कॉफी का शौकीन होगा। वो कॉफी रेगुलर पिएगा ही पिएगा। चाहे कुछ भी हो
says: If Neptune is in a good sign and active in this house, the person will love coffee and will drink it regularly whatever happens.
cells_derived_method: 'Good sign' is not defined; reasonable reading is a sign friendly to Neptune (Venus's, Jupiter's, water signs). In a hostile sign the coffee habit is replaced by other cravings.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Neptune in the 2nd in Pisces (lagna Aquarius), a water sign; strong coffee habit under his rule.
Derived: Neptune in the 2nd in Libra (lagna Virgo), Venus's sign where Neptune is at home in his scheme; daily coffee ritual.

ambiguity: 'अच्छी राशि' is undefined; 'संतुष्ट' (satisfied) suggests a comfortable placement.

hindi: जो रेगुलरली कॉफी पीता है उसका नेप्च्यून यहां यहां यहां से यहां आके यहां शिफ्टिंग करके असर दे रहा है यह गारंटी है या इन तीन जगह पर है
says: Whoever drinks coffee regularly has Neptune acting through one of three places in the chart, by shifting between nearby houses; he calls it a guarantee. The three places are likely the 1st, 2nd and 3rd houses.
cells_derived_method: The reverse inference (coffee habit implies Neptune in houses 1-3) works only if the house span concept is used; the coffee habit shows with the Neptune sign and house span chosen.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Neptune in the 1st in Gemini (lagna Gemini); habitual coffee and talk.
Derived: Neptune in the 3rd in Leo (lagna Gemini); coffee as a social habit with showy communication.

ambiguity: 'इन तीन जगह' is unspecified; houses 1, 2 and 3 are inferred from the preceding discussion, and he uses a pointer 'यहां से यहां' on a chart.

hindi: कॉफी का शौकीन होगा चॉकलेट का शौकीन होगा कोक पिएगा उसको शौक होगा इन चीजों का बहुत ज्यादा उसका नियम सा होगा ऐसा नहीं कि चसका है लेकिन नेप्च्यून एडिक्शन का देवता है आप एडिक्टेड होते हो
says: The person will be fond of coffee, chocolate and cola as a fixed routine, and Neptune, the god of addiction, makes him dependent on them.

hindi: यार पूल विला लेंगे अपुन तो भाई जो करेंगे ग्रैंड करेंगे भाई अपना पर्सनल पूल विला लेंगे महंगा है कोई बात नहीं पैसे आ जाएंगे
says: Mock voice of the Neptune person: I will buy a personal pool villa, whatever I do will be grand, it is expensive but the money will come; shows grand thinking with confidence that funds appear.
ambiguity: Illustrative talk; not a promise of actual wealth.

hindi: उनकी पॉजिटिविटी ये होगी दे विल ऑलवेज हैव मनी।
says: The positive side of this placement is that these people will always have money.

hindi: उनके पास अनजानों से रिश्ते होंगे। अपने रिश्तों का क्या होगा? झूठे अपने आप में झूठा। अपने रिश्तों का लाभ नहीं होगा।
says: They will have relationships with strangers, while their own relations will be false and give no benefit.

hindi: नए रिश्ते ऐसे बनेंगे बिल्कुल रिश्तेदारों की तरह। बहुत गजब के मित्र सेवकों की बड़ी भारी कृपा रहेगी। सेवक अपने नहीं होते।
says: New relationships will form that feel just like family, and friends and servants will favour him greatly; servants are not blood relations.
ambiguity: Sentence ends at chunk edge.

hindi: पराए होते हैं लेकिन अपने बन जाते हैं। ये पॉजिटिविटी इसके अंदर देता है।
says: These helpers are outsiders who become one's own people; this is the positive result Neptune gives in the 2nd house.

hindi: बदलाव, झूठ धन कमाने के झूठे प्लान, विलासिता, कोकेन एडिक्शन होगी तो वीड की एडिक्शन होगी।
says: Neptune in the 2nd brings change, falsehood and false money-making plans, luxury, and addiction to cocaine or to weed.
ambiguity: Addiction claim as tendency; not a diagnosis.

hindi: इसलिए ऐसे बच्चों के लिए बड़ी भारी समस्या है।
says: Because of this pattern, it becomes a heavy problem for children born with this placement.

hindi: भाई दारू ही पी लेता तो इससे नहीं वो वीड लेगा।
says: A parent would say 'better if he drank liquor', but this child will take weed instead; the 2nd-house Neptune child prefers cannabis to alcohol.

hindi: तो यह मान के चले जितने लोग स्मोकिंग के थ्रू यह वाला काम कर रहे हैं सेकंड हाउस के अंदर मतलब वो स्मोकर तो होएंगे ही। यह तो होने ही है।
says: Take it as fixed: people who get this Neptune effect through smoking have it through the 2nd house, so they will surely be smokers; it is bound to happen.
cells_derived_method: The 2nd house covers the mouth and face, so smoking is linked with it; the sign changes how strong the habit is.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Neptune in the 2nd in Aries (lagna Pisces), fire sign, smoking fits the fire element.
Derived: Neptune in the 2nd in Virgo (lagna Leo), earth and Mercury; habit mixed with health worry.

ambiguity: Overconfident claim; no measurement.
classical_check: Silent; 2nd as the mouth and face is classical.

hindi: यह तीसरे घर के साथ भी है। यहां का ग्रह यहां घूम सकता है। यहां का यहां घूम सकता है। यहां का यहां भी घूम सकता है।
says: The same effect also applies to the 3rd house, and a planet counted in one house can shift into the neighbouring house; so house membership is fluid across the span.
cells_derived_method: A planet near a house boundary (in a bhava-chalit or multi-sign view) can act as if in the next house. The 2nd and 3rd are neighbours, so Neptune late in the 2nd may deliver 3rd-house results.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Neptune late in the 2nd in Gemini (lagna Taurus), near the boundary with the 3rd, may behave as a 3rd-house planet.
Derived: Neptune early in the 3rd in Cancer (lagna Taurus), close to the 2nd boundary, may also give 2nd-house results.

ambiguity: Pointing gestures ('यहां का यहां') are not readable from the caption.
classical_check: Agrees with bhava-chalit shifting in principle.

hindi: यह हमारी मुन्ना भाई की कुंडली इसलिए बहुत इंपॉर्टेंट है। उसमें सायन स्पष्ट होता है। एक लहरी स्पष्ट है। एक रमन का है। एक सायन है। एक केपी कुंडली है।
says: The Munna Bhai chart is important because it shows the same planets in several systems: sayana positions, Lahiri positions, Raman ayanamsa, and a KP chart, so the same planet can fall in different signs and houses across them.
cells_derived_method: A planet near a sign boundary can change sign between ayanamsas (Lahiri versus Raman differ by about 1 degree 20 minutes; sayana differs by about 24 degrees), which shifts the cell read.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: a planet read as the 2nd in Taurus in Lahiri could fall in Gemini in sayana (about 24 degrees ahead), and the house also changes if the sayana lagna moves.

ambiguity: 'एक लहरी स्पष्ट' means Lahiri; the example chart is not given in the caption.
classical_check: Ayanamsa choice is a known practice difference; CLAUDE.md here fixes Lahiri.

gist: Says this is so complicated that learners of astrology classes will tire and say collect this much first.
Class plan: after this, classes will focus on the main planets, take a rest, and then move to other topics.
Says the mood for astrology has come up, a short transition back into the Neptune-in-3rd-house topic.

hindi: तो तीसरा घर जो है आपका यह आपका कम्युनिकेशन का है। बातचीत का है। आप कितना लोगों से सोशलाइज कर सकते हैं। संचार माध्यम का है।
says: The 3rd house stands for communication, conversation, how much you can socialise with people, and the media of communication.
classical_check: Agrees: the 3rd house covers communication, courage, short travel and siblings; media is a modern extension.

hindi: टेलीफोन दूरसंचार का माध्यम मूड चेंजिंग ड्रग्स।
says: Telephone and telecom belong to the 3rd house, and with Neptune there the person turns to mood-changing drugs.
cells_derived_method: Neptune in the 3rd links telecom (house topic) with mood-altering substances (planet topic); the sign adds the style: Gemini or Virgo (Mercury) leans to talk and nerves, Aries or Scorpio (Mars) to sharper stimulants, water signs to sedatives.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Neptune in the 3rd in Gemini (lagna Aries); Mercury sign, mood substances tied to talk, phone and nervous energy.
Derived: Neptune in the 3rd in Pisces (lagna Capricorn); water sign, sedative or alcohol-type mood changes.

ambiguity: Fragmentary caption; the two topics (telecom, drugs) are read as a list of 3rd-house/Neptune links.

hindi: आपके ऐसे इललीगल ड्रग्स लेता है। ऐसे व्यक्ति जो मूड को चेंज करते हैं।
says: Neptune in the 3rd can lead a person to illegal drugs of the kind that change mood.
ambiguity: A tendency claim, not a diagnosis.

hindi: यानी ऐसे व्यक्ति को अपनी कुछ ना कुछ बीमारी के लिए हर समय कोई ना कोई ड्रग लेना ही पड़ता है।
says: Such a person ends up always needing some drug or medicine for some ailment or other; a health-related claim recorded as his statement, not a diagnosis.

hindi: ड्रग को हम दवाई भी कह सकते हैं। ड्रग को हम ड्रग एडिक्शन भी कह सकते हैं, दारू भी कह सकते हैं।
says: By 'drug' in this rule he means three things: medicine, drug addiction, and also liquor, so the Neptune reading covers all of them.

hindi: यानी ऐसे व्यक्ति के लिए जब जब वो मूड ट्विस्ट करना होता है तो वह थोड़ा बहुत ड्रग्स ले सकते हैं या अल्कोहल ले सकते हैं।
says: Whenever such a person wants to twist or change his mood, he may take some drugs or alcohol in small amounts.

hindi: ऐसे व्यक्तियों को लत लग जाती है थोड़ी सी नशे की।
says: These people pick up a mild habit of intoxication; the dependence is slight, not severe.

hindi: भाई बहनों से परेशान अगर यह तीसरे घर का नेप्च्यून आता है नौवें घर से तीसरे पे दृष्टि आ जाए या तीसरे का ही बैठा है तो कोई ना कोई भाई या बहन उसका ड्रग एडिक्ट होगा ही
says: If Neptune sits in the 3rd, or aspects the 3rd from the 9th, then some brother or sister of the person will certainly be a drug addict; he treats it as a sure result.
cells_derived_method: Sibling addiction follows from the 3rd house topic (siblings) plus Neptune's drug theme. The sign chosen modifies the type of addiction: air signs smoking or pills, water signs alcohol, fire signs stimulants, earth signs food or sugar.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Neptune in the 3rd in Scorpio (lagna Virgo); water sign, a sibling with alcohol or hidden drug habits.
Derived: Neptune in the 9th in Libra (lagna Aquarius) aspecting the 3rd; a sibling with a habit tied to social drinking or pleasure.
Derived: Neptune in the 3rd in Taurus (lagna Pisces); earth sign, sibling's addiction linked to food, sugar or comfort.

ambiguity: Taking the 9th-to-3rd aspect as 7th aspect; he does not name it here, though he later says Neptune has multiple aspects.

hindi: किसी ना किसी भाई या बहन से उसका झगड़ा होगा ही
says: The person will certainly quarrel with some brother or sister; sibling conflict is a sure result of Neptune in or aspecting the 3rd.
ambiguity: Grammatically one run-on sentence with the previous row.

hindi: उसका एक भाई या बहन ऐसा होगा जो हो के मर गया या हुआ तो मरे समान है भी तो नहीं है
says: One brother or sister will be such that he or she died after being born, or is as good as dead and absent; a sibling loss or absence is recorded as his claim, without any date.
ambiguity: 'मरे समान' (as good as dead) can mean estranged or absent, not necessarily dead.
classical_check: Silent on Neptune; the 3rd house is classical for sibling matters, and affliction there is read for sibling trouble.

hindi: उस भाई को हम बोल तो दें लेकिन यार उससे बोला नहीं जाता उसकी मदद नहीं ले सकते उस बहन की फायदा नहीं उठा सकते उसको बताया नहीं जा सकता
says: Such a sibling cannot be spoken to or advised, his or her help cannot be taken and no benefit can be had from that brother or sister; there is a block in dealing with him or her.

hindi: और किसी भाई या बहन के पास आपका पैसा जरूर मरेगा चाहे कुछ भी हो जाए
says: Your money held by or lent to a sibling will surely be lost, whatever happens; a money-loss claim tied to the 3rd house Neptune.
ambiguity: A claim about personal lending, not investment advice.

hindi: थोड़ा सा एक कंधे की या कान की तकलीफ आपको आ सकती है बहुत ही लाइट
says: A very light trouble in one shoulder or ear can come; the 3rd house governs shoulders and ears, and the effect is mild (a body-area tendency, not a diagnosis).
classical_check: Agrees that the 3rd house governs arms, shoulders and ears (Kalapurusha reading).

hindi: और कि पता नहीं चलता इस प्लनेट का इसलिए ऐसी तकलीफ हो गई कि पता ही नहीं क्या थी हो गई फिर ठीक हो गई
says: This planet's effect is hard to spot, so the trouble comes as something nobody can identify, happens, and then goes away on its own.
ambiguity: The caption repeats this phrase twice; counted once.

hindi: जैसे लोगों के कान में हवा भर जाती है आधे सिर में दर्द हो जाता है साइड में सर्वाइकल आती नहीं जरा सी दर्द रहती है उससे दिक्कत कोई नहीं आती लेकिन वो है थोड़ी सी है ही
says: Examples of the vague trouble: air filling the ear, half-head pain, a slight side or cervical pain; it causes no real difficulty, but a bit of it is always there. These are his illustrations, not diagnoses.

hindi: यह क्लेश चलता ही चलता
says: The friction (with siblings) goes on and on; a low steady quarrel is part of the pattern.
ambiguity: Short fragment; 'क्लेश' is read as ongoing strife.

hindi: ओसीडी जैसी बिहेवियर अजीब व्यवहार
says: OCD-like behaviour and strange conduct are possible with Neptune in the 3rd (a behavioural description, not a clinical diagnosis).

hindi: पांच इंद्रियों से परे खुला हुआ मन
says: The mind is open beyond the five senses; Neptune in the 3rd gives an extra-sensory open mind.

hindi: यह इसकी एक पॉजिटिविटी यह है कि यहां से ये नौवें घर पे दृष्टि देता है तो भयंकर इंट्यूटिव पावर्स देता है
says: The positive side: from the 3rd house Neptune looks at the 9th house, and so it gives tremendous intuitive power.
cells_derived_method: Intuition arises from the aspect on the 9th (higher mind); the sign of the 3rd decides how it shows: Gemini or Virgo as speech-based insight, water signs as feeling-based intuition.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Neptune in the 3rd in Cancer (lagna Taurus); intuition felt as emotion and mother-linked hunches.
Derived: Neptune in the 3rd in Sagittarius (lagna Libra); intuition expressed as prophecy-like statements.

classical_check: 7th aspect from the 3rd to the 9th is standard geometry; Neptune is his addition.

hindi: ऐसे व्यक्तियों का साथ एक डर होता है वो मुंह से कुछ बोल देते हैं पता नहीं सच हो जाता है कई बार
says: With such people comes a fear: whatever they say with their mouth often turns out true, without them knowing why.
classical_check: Silent; 'vak siddhi' is a tradition idea tied to other combinations.

hindi: और अगर वो रियलाइजेशन वाला हो तो उसे खुद पता होगा क्या बोलना है सच हो के ही रहेगा ये होगा
says: If the person is self-realised, he will know what to say, and what he says will definitely come true.
ambiguity: The sentence is cut at the chunk edge ('ये होगा | ही पर बोलेंगे').

hindi: ही पर बोलेंगे बहुत ज्यादा ऐसे लोग
says: Such people will talk a great deal even though what they say tends to come true.
ambiguity: Starts mid-sentence; the first words ('ये होगा') sit in the previous chunk.

hindi: ये चौथे घर का है चतुर्थ भाव बहुत अच्छे गार्डियंस होते हैं ऐसे लोग मतलब यह खुद ही मम्मी है।
says: Neptune in the 4th house makes very good guardians; the person himself behaves like a mother.
cells_derived_method: The caring-guardian trait rises with the Moon's water signs (Cancer, Scorpio, Pisces) and is smaller in dry or fire signs where the nurturing is replaced by control or restlessness.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Neptune in the 4th in Cancer (lagna Aries); Moon's own sign, the strongest mother-like caretaker.
Derived: Neptune in the 4th in Aries (lagna Capricorn); fire sign, caring is defensive and combative.
Derived: Neptune in the 4th in Libra (lagna Cancer); air and Venus, caring through giving comfort and harmony.

classical_check: Silent on Neptune; the 4th house is the house of mother and home.

hindi: ऐसा व्यक्ति जो है चौथे घर के नेपच्यून का यही मम्मी है। यह मम्मी का घर है।
says: The 4th house is the mother's house, so a person with Neptune there plays the mother role for others.
classical_check: Agrees: the 4th is the house of the mother.

hindi: या ऐसे व्यक्ति की मदद अल्कोहलिक हो सकती है या हो सकता है पूरी स्पिरिचुअल हो।
says: The mother of such a person (the word reads 'help' but fits 'mother') may be an alcoholic or may be completely spiritual; two opposite possibilities.
cells_derived_method: Which pole shows depends on the sign: water or Jupiter signs (Cancer, Pisces, Sagittarius) lean spiritual; Venus or Mars signs lean toward indulgence.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Neptune in the 4th in Pisces (lagna Sagittarius); a spiritual mother is more likely.
Derived: Neptune in the 4th in Taurus (lagna Aquarius); a mother with sensual indulgence, food or drink habits.

ambiguity: 'मदद' (help) is probably a caption error for 'मां' (mother), since the next sentences are about the mother.

hindi: पूरे धर्म में यानी कोई ऐसा धर्म जो धर्म नहीं है। यानी कि एक गुरुद्वारे का धर्म है। एक सनातन धर्म है, एक इस्लाम का धर्म है, एक बुद्ध धर्म है। और कई मत है, मत और संप्रदाय उसको मानने वाले होंगे।
says: The spiritual mother may belong fully to any faith or even a belief that is not a formal religion: Sikh, Sanatan, Islamic, Buddhist, or one of many sects and cults; the Neptune-4th home is open to all paths.
ambiguity: Lists religions as examples, not as a rule about specific signs.

hindi: ऐसे माता-पिता ऐसी मां हो जो कि ऐसे को माने और घर में एक ऐसी कोई ना कोई मासी मामी फीमेल जो मां समान होती है ऐसी कोई ना कोई जरूर होगी जिसका होना ना होना बराबर हो
says: The parents or mother will follow such a path, and in the home there will certainly be some mother-like woman such as an aunt whose presence or absence makes no difference.

hindi: यानी हर जगह एक चीज को वो होना ना होना बराबर करता ही करता है निपटा देता है खत्म कर देता है
says: General Neptune effect: it reduces a thing to 'present or absent, no difference', neutralising and finishing it off; things that should matter lose their effect.

hindi: केयरटेकर बहुत तगड़े होते हैं ऐसे लोग
says: Such people become very strong caretakers.

hindi: सारा प्लास्टिक का सामान घर के अंदर सारी विटामिन इत्यादि की दवाइयां
says: The home will be full of plastic goods and vitamin-type medicines; Neptune in the 4th (house of home) fills the home with synthetic items.

hindi: ऐसे लोगों को विटामिनस लेने पड़ते हैं अगर खुद नहीं लेगा तो उसकी मदर लेगी विटामिन डेफिशिएंसी का हिसाब किताब बन सकता है।
says: Such people need vitamins, and if he does not take them, his mother will; a vitamin-deficiency picture can develop in the family (health claim recorded as his).
ambiguity: Health statement; not a diagnosis.

hindi: जितना प्रोसेस्ड फूड है, बेबी फूड है, यह इस घर के अंदर जरूर होता है।
says: All processed food and baby food belongs to this house and is sure to be present with Neptune in the 4th.

hindi: यानी प्रोसेस्ड फूड का शौकीन होता है ऐसा व्यक्ति।
says: So a person with Neptune in the 4th is fond of processed food.

hindi: चौथा जिसका नेप्च्यून हो जाए, उसको प्रोसेस बना बनाया फास्ट फूड का शौकीन हो जाएगा।
says: Anyone whose Neptune lands in the 4th will develop a taste for ready-made processed fast food.

hindi: ये चीजें इसके अंदर बननी ही बननी है।
says: These habits are bound to form in such a person, he says with no exception.
ambiguity: Overconfident; no measurement.

hindi: हां, घर की प्रॉब्लम सबसे बड़ी है।
says: For Neptune in the 4th, the biggest problem is the home itself.

hindi: चौथे घर में ऐसा होता है तो घर में पानी का रिसाब और दीमक, मोल्स ये सब आ सकते हैं।
says: With Neptune in the 4th, the house may suffer water seepage, termites and moles or mould; water and pest damage to the building.
ambiguity: 'मोल्स' could mean moles (animals) or mould.

gist: Says remedies exist for this and he will cover them after the class is complete.

hindi: फिर आता है पांचवा भाव। पांचवा भाव एक्चुअली पांच नंबर है। यह चार नंबर था चंद्रमा का।
says: Next comes the 5th house, which is actually number five; number four was the Moon's.
ambiguity: 'चार नंबर था चंद्रमा का' means Cancer (sign 4) and the 4th house, both Moon's.
classical_check: Agrees: Moon is the natural lord of the 4th house and Cancer.

hindi: यह पांचवा नंबर है। यह पंचम भाव जो है यह सूर्य की राशि है।
says: Number five, the 5th house, corresponds to the Sun's sign (Leo).
ambiguity: Mixes house five and sign five, as in earlier rows.
classical_check: Agrees: Leo is the Sun's sign and the natural 5th.

hindi: अब सूरज क्या है? वह भी गर्म है। ताप है।
says: The Sun is hot; it is heat.
classical_check: Agrees: the Sun is a hot, fiery planet.

hindi: और समुद्र क्या है? पानी है। वो उसके पास जाएगा। पॉसिबिलिटी नहीं है। दोनों को एक्सिस्ट नहीं कर सकता।
says: The sea is water; when it goes near the Sun they cannot coexist, so Neptune and the Sun do not work together.
cells_derived_method: The clash applies when Neptune is in a Sun-ruled place (Leo or the 5th house). In other fire signs the clash is weaker and in water signs it disappears.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Neptune in the 5th in Leo (lagna Aries) is the full clash, water with the Sun's fire.
Derived: Neptune in the 9th in Leo (lagna Sagittarius); the sign has the clash but the trine house is less hostile.

classical_check: Silent; Sun-Neptune relation is his own element argument.

hindi: इसलिए चार नंबर का पांच नंबर का नेप्च्यून अच्छा नहीं है।
says: So Neptune at number four and number five is not good, he says; the 4th and 5th are both named as bad for Neptune.
ambiguity: Contradicts his own element argument: the 4th/Cancer is water, which suits Neptune, and he gave positive results for the 4th a minute before; probably he means only the 5th.

hindi: क्योंकि पांच नंबर की राशि क्या है? आपकी अह सूर्य की राशि और सूर्य गर्म देवता। तो पानी को भी गर्म कर देगा ये।
says: The reason: the 5th sign is the Sun's sign and the Sun is a hot deity, so it will heat even the water of Neptune.

hindi: तो ऐसी स्थिति में क्या होगा? आपका बच्चा गर्म स्वभाव का होगा।
says: With Neptune in the 5th (Sun's place), your child will be hot-tempered by nature.
cells_derived_method: Child temperament follows the 5th house topic (children); fire signs (Aries, Leo, Sagittarius) and Mars or Sun-ruled signs raise heat, water signs reduce it.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Neptune in the 5th in Leo (lagna Aries); child shows Sun-like pride and heat.
Derived: Neptune in the 5th in Pisces (lagna Scorpio); water sign, child is softer and dreamier.

classical_check: Silent on Neptune; the 5th house is the house of children.

hindi: आपका बच्चा वो होगा ही नहीं जो आप सोचते हो। आपकी पढ़ाई से वो फायदा मिलेगा ही नहीं जो आप सोचते हो।
says: Your child will not turn out as you imagine, and your education will not bring the benefit you expect; expectations about children and studies fail.
classical_check: Silent; the 5th house also stands for education.

hindi: यह घर जो है वैसा होएगा ही नहीं जो सोचा था।
says: The home will not become what you had thought; Neptune breaks your picture of the house.
ambiguity: Said in the 5th-house discussion but the topic (home) is the 4th; applies to Neptune generally.

hindi: यह भाई बहन वैसे होएंगे ही नहीं जो सोचे।
says: Brothers and sisters will not be what you thought they would be.
ambiguity: Siblings are the 3rd house topic; said within the 5th-house discussion.

hindi: धन वैसा होएगा ही नहीं जो सोचा था। क्योंकि यह लिमिटलेस प्लनेट है।
says: Wealth will not come as expected, because Neptune is the limitless planet that never matches planned amounts.
ambiguity: Wealth is a 2nd-house topic; said under the 5th-house heading.

hindi: तो ऐसे में आपके साथ यह स्थिति बनती है कि आपको इललीगल सूट करता है।
says: With Neptune in the 5th the person finds illegitimate or irregular things suit him; in this house Neptune brings irregular, outside-the-rule arrangements.
ambiguity: 'इललीगल' could mean illegitimate (children, relations) or illegal; he goes on to talk about adopted relations, so illegitimate or unofficial is likely.

hindi: एक ऐसा भाई या बहन सूट करेगा जो है भी और नहीं भी। बाहर से ही है। वो मित्र इतना प्यारा मित्र भाई बहन बन गया है।
says: A sibling who both exists and does not, an outsider, will suit him: a dear friend who has become like a brother or sister.

hindi: ये एक मदर या फादर ऐसे होंगे कि मदरफादर में शिफ्टिंग होती है। मदर या फादर ऐसे होंगे कि गोद लिए मां है। एक उससे फायदा होगा।
says: The person's mother or father figure may shift; there will be an adoptive parent, a mother taken as one's own, and one benefit comes from that figure.
ambiguity: 'शिफ्टिंग' may mean a substitute parent figure takes the place of the real one.

hindi: ये गोद लिया बच्चा होगा। यानी आप संसार के समाज के बच्चों को भी कहोगे मेरे बच्चे हैं। यार कोई बात नहीं। यह पांचव घर का है।
says: An adopted child will be there; you will call society's children your own, and it does not matter; this belongs to the 5th house (children).
cells_derived_method: Adoption or a child outside the family tree follows from Neptune's unclear boundaries in the 5th. The sign sets the style: water signs adopt through care, air signs through teaching or social work.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Neptune in the 5th in Cancer (lagna Pisces); nurturing others' children as own.
Derived: Neptune in the 5th in Aquarius (lagna Libra); a social-cause guardian of many children.

classical_check: Silent on Neptune; adoption in the 5th is read from Saturn, Rahu and other combinations in classical texts.

hindi: कानूनी बहुत ज्यादा प्राइड बहुत रॉयल टशन यह सब चीजें आपकी दिखावे की रहेंग।
says: Great pride, a royal style and swagger will all be a show-off display for such a person; the Sun's pride appears only as appearance.
ambiguity: 'कानूनी' (legal) at the start looks like a caption error, maybe 'कुल मिलाकर' or similar; ignored.

hindi: झूठ तो पढ़ा लिखा होकर भी लाभ नहीं होने देगा।
says: Falsehood will not let you benefit even if you are well educated; Neptune's lie cancels the gains of learning.

hindi: यह नेप्च्यून के दोष से होगा।
says: All this happens because of the fault or affliction of Neptune.

hindi: नशे का आदि बनाता है ये फॉर श्योर।
says: Neptune in the 5th makes a person an addict for sure; he states it without a doubt.

hindi: आपका बच्चा नशे का आदि होगा।
says: Your child will be addicted to intoxicants; the 5th house is the child, so the child is the one affected.

gist: Repeats that your child will be addicted to intoxicants.

hindi: अगर वो स्मोक करता है। सोचो बड़ी भारी कृपा है। कि वो ड्रग्स नहीं ले रहा।
says: If the child only smokes, count it a great grace that he is not taking drugs; smoking is the milder form of Neptune's addiction.

hindi: अन्यथा उसको दवाई लेनी ही पड़ेगी। वो दवाइयां ले रहा है वो भी ड्रग्स हैं।
says: Otherwise the child will have to take medicines, and medicines are drugs too; Neptune's addiction route may be through prescribed pills.

hindi: तो सारी की सारी सिंथेटिक और केमिकल दवाइयां यह देगा ही।
says: Neptune gives all the synthetic and chemical medicines.

hindi: जैसे बॉडी बिल्डर बन जाते हैं बच्चे आजकल कहते हैं मैंने तो प्रोटीन शेक लेना है ये लेना है। बहुत लोग लेते हैं
says: Example: young bodybuilders taking protein shakes and supplements are also under Neptune's synthetic-substance theme.
ambiguity: Supplements are not named as Neptune explicitly; read from the flow.

hindi: अब तो तो ये दृष्टियां आती है। नेप्च्यून की एक खासियत क्या है? इसकी सब जगह मल्टीपल दृष्टि है।
says: Neptune's special feature is that it has multiple aspects everywhere, not one fixed aspect; so its influence reaches many houses from any seat.
cells_derived_method: If Neptune aspects multiple houses from any seat, the result of every placement must be read for several aspected houses, not only the 7th; the exact aspect pattern is not given here.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Neptune in the 3rd in Aries (lagna Aquarius) could be read to touch the 9th and further houses, with the extra aspects unspecified.
Derived: Neptune in the 5th in Pisces (lagna Scorpio) would likewise influence several other houses, if multiple aspects are accepted; which ones is not stated.

ambiguity: He does not say which houses are aspected beyond the earlier 9th-to-3rd and 3rd-to-9th examples; those are 7th aspects.
classical_check: Differs from classical practice, where Saturn, Mars and Jupiter have special aspects and outer planets are not used.

hindi: इसलिए अपने जीवन में हर व्यक्ति धरती हर व्यक्ति देर सवेेर स्पिरिचुअल हो ही जाता है।
says: Because Neptune aspects everywhere, every person on earth becomes spiritual sooner or later in life.

hindi: उसके मन में इतनी सी स्पिरिचुअल घंटी अपनी है ही
says: Everyone has a small spiritual bell in the mind that eventually rings.

hindi: और येकि अजीब किस्म से मनवाता है बात तो ऐसे हर व्यक्ति के अंदर ना एक अजीब किस्म से अपने धर्म को मानने की सनक है।
says: Neptune makes people believe in odd ways, and each person carries a strange obsession for following his own religion.

hindi: और किसी किसी बड़ी अजीब किस्म की लतें उसमें होंगी।
says: Some people will have very strange kinds of addictions; Neptune's pull appears as odd habits.

hindi: किसी को शराब की लत हो सकती है। किसी को गंगा जाने की लत हो सकती है।
says: One person's addiction may be liquor, another's may be going to the Ganga; Neptune's addiction can be a vice or a religious habit.

hindi: कोई हर हफ्ते कहेगा मैं माता वैष्णो देवी जाता हूं। यात्रा करूंगा ही करूंगा। कोई हनुमान मंदिर जाने की लत लत तो ये प्लस लत
says: Someone will say he goes to Mata Vaishno Devi every week and must make the pilgrimage; another has an addiction to visiting a Hanuman temple; he calls this the positive kind of addiction.
ambiguity: 'प्लस लत' is read as a positive or good addiction; the sentence is cut at the end.

hindi: या माइनस लत ये लत देता है देगा ही देगा
says: Neptune in the 5th definitely gives an addiction, either of the positive kind (devotion, pilgrimage) or the negative kind (vices); it is certain that some craving comes.
cells_derived_method: The type of addiction depends on the sign of the 5th-house Neptune: water or Jupiter signs lean toward the positive, devotional type; Venus, Mars or Rahu-like signs lean toward vices.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Neptune in the 5th in Pisces (lagna Scorpio); devotion or meditation habit more likely.
Derived: Neptune in the 5th in Libra (lagna Gemini); pleasure, parties and romance habits more likely.

ambiguity: 'या माइनस लत' begins at the chunk edge, with 'plus' coming from the end of the previous chunk.

hindi: जुए में लिप्त बच्चे
says: Children involved in gambling, a result he lists for Neptune in the 5th.
ambiguity: A fragment; read as part of the list of 5th-house Neptune results.
classical_check: Silent; gambling and speculation are classically 5th and 8th.

hindi: अवैध संतान
says: Illegitimate offspring, another listed result of Neptune in the 5th.
ambiguity: Could mean outside-marriage children or unofficially adopted ones, as he spoke of adoption earlier.

hindi: बहुत पढ़ा लिखा रोकर भी लाभ नहीं
says: Even a very educated person gets no benefit; the education does not pay off (the word 'रोकर' is probably 'होकर').
ambiguity: 'रोकर' (crying) is likely a caption error for 'होकर' (being).

hindi: हॉलीवुड के शौकीन यह पक्की गारंटी है कि इन लोगों को मतलब दूसरी भाषाएं हॉलीवुड मींस जिसमें बहुत जबरदस्त एंटरटेनमेंट है पार्टी वाली
says: These people are surely fond of Hollywood, meaning films in other languages with lavish entertainment and party scenes; a firm claim for Neptune in the 5th (house of entertainment).
classical_check: Silent; entertainment is classically the 5th house.

hindi: क्योंकि पार्टी कराएगा ये जो वरुण है यह बहुत विशाल है इसके साथ जो भी पार्टी होती है बहुत जोरदार होती है भयंकर बिग साइज ग्रैंड तो ये ग्रैंड पार्टी करते हैं।
says: Neptune is vast, so any party connected to it is huge, forceful and grand; these people hold grand parties.

hindi: इसमें क्या होता है? अपने तो खाए खाए तू भी खा और ऐश और पार्टी तो इसमें चाहिए ही चाहिए।
says: The mood of these people: I eat, you eat too, enjoyment and parties are a must in this placement.

hindi: छठा भाव जो है ये आपके जीवन के अंदर आर्ट देता है। आर्ट्स एंड क्राफ्ट स्किल्स देता है। आप में कितने स्किल्स हैं आप? कितने स्किलफुल हो।
says: The 6th house gives art, arts and crafts, skills; it shows how skilful you are.
classical_check: Differs: classically the 6th is about enemies, debts, disease, service and daily work; skill as work competence is an accepted reading but art and craft is his own emphasis.

hindi: अब यहां क्या था? बच्चे हैं लेकिन अपनी उम्मीद के अनुसार नहीं। दूसरों के बच्चे अपने यहां
says: Recap of the 5th: children exist but not as you expected, and other people's children become like your own.
ambiguity: The sentence is cut off ('दूसरों के बच्चे अपने यहां'); the end is guessed from the earlier adoption claim.

hindi: शत्रु उम्मीद के अनुसार नहीं।
says: Enemies will not be as you expect, the first result he states for Neptune in the 6th.
ambiguity: Starts the 6th house results.
classical_check: Silent on Neptune; 6th house is the house of enemies.

hindi: शत्रुओं का नाश कर देता है। ये इतना बड़ा देवता है कि यहां बैठा हुआ होगा। तो आपके शत्रु कहां गायब हो जाएंगे पता नहीं चलेगा।
says: Neptune in the 6th destroys enemies; it is such a big deity that your enemies vanish without you knowing where they went.
cells_derived_method: Enemy destruction is the 6th-house topic multiplied by Neptune's power; in a strong sign (water or friendly) the effect is clean, while in a hostile sign it may turn on the person himself.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Neptune in the 6th in Scorpio (lagna Gemini); water sign, enemies melt away quietly.
Derived: Neptune in the 6th in Leo (lagna Pisces); fire sign of the Sun, the clash may leave open conflict rather than quiet disappearance.

classical_check: Agrees in principle with the classical idea that benefics or strong planets in the 6th destroy enemies; Neptune is his addition.

hindi: ऐसे शत्रु होंगे जो लगेगा जीते जीते जीते जीते हार गए। शत्रु होना ना होना बराबर कर देता है।
says: The enemies seem to be winning, winning, and then they lose; Neptune makes their existence equal to non-existence.

hindi: ये उड़ा के खत्म कर देगा।
says: Neptune will blow the enemy away and finish it, a continuation of the enemy-destroying claim.

hindi: आपको एंटीबायोटिक रेजिस्टेंस हो जाएगी।
says: You will develop antibiotic resistance with Neptune in the 6th (a health-related claim recorded as his).
ambiguity: A health claim; not endorsed.
classical_check: Silent; the 6th house is classically the house of disease.

hindi: छठे नेप्च्यून वाले व्यक्ति को 100% ऐसी बीमारी होगी जो दवाई से ठीक ही ना हो।
says: A person with Neptune in the 6th will with certainty (100 percent) have an illness that does not get cured by medicine; recorded as his claim, not a medical statement.
ambiguity: '100%' is his emphasis, not a measured rate.
classical_check: Silent; the 6th as house of disease is classical.

hindi: ऐसा व्यक्ति शराब पी ही नहीं सकता। अगर वो थोड़ी सी पी लेगा उसको ऐसा हैंग ओवर होगा। उसके सिर में दर्द रहेगा।
says: Such a person cannot drink liquor at all; even a little gives a severe hangover and headache.
ambiguity: This reverses the usual Neptune-alcohol link he gave for the 1st and 3rd houses.

hindi: दवाई ले ले मर जाए पी नहीं पाता। कहते हैं ना दारू पचती नहीं। दवाई पचती ही नहीं।
says: He cannot take liquor or medicine even under pressure; liquor does not digest, and medicine does not digest either; the body rejects both.
ambiguity: 'मर जाए' is an idiom for 'whatever happens'.

hindi: जितनी केमिकल की चीजें लेगा ऐसा व्यक्ति केमिकली केमिकली सिंथेटिक आर्टिफिशियली मेड सारी दवाइयां सारी चीजें वरुण है।
says: Whatever chemical, synthetic and artificially made medicines and things such a person takes are all Neptune, and in the 6th they do not suit him.

hindi: यानी एक झूठा ब्रह्मांड झूठा सामान समुद्र की गहराई में क्या पता ही नहीं।
says: Neptune is a false universe of false goods, like the unknown depth of the sea; nobody knows what is there.

hindi: तो नेप्च्यून यहां पर आपको अपनी ही दवाइयों का रिलीफ नहीं होने देगा।
says: Neptune in the 6th will not let you get relief even from your own medicines.

hindi: गरीब और जो अनपढ़ लोग हैं उनका पूर्ण सत्यानाश कर देगा।
says: For poor and uneducated people, a Neptune like this can ruin them completely.
ambiguity: Unclear whether he means Neptune in the 6th only or Neptune in general.

hindi: अगर नेगेटिव राशि का है और अच्छी राशि का है तो लाजवाब उठाएगा। एकदम जो नीचे कहते हैं ना फर्श से लेके अर्श पे पहुंचा दिया।
says: If Neptune is in a good sign it lifts the person marvellously, from the floor to the throne; in a negative sign the result is the ruin he described just before.
cells_derived_method: The sign test decides whether the 6th-house Neptune ruins or lifts. His 'good sign' is not defined; a reasonable reading is a water sign or a sign of a friend (Venus, Jupiter).

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Neptune in the 6th in Pisces (lagna Libra); water and Jupiter's sign, rising from nothing to high status.
Derived: Neptune in the 6th in Aries (lagna Scorpio); fire sign, the 'negative' case with ruin or conflict.

ambiguity: 'नेगेटिव राशि' and 'अच्छी राशि' are not defined; the caption may be garbled.
classical_check: Silent; sign-based modifying of planetary results is classical in general.

hindi: वो यहां का काम है। जितने एग्रीकल्चर है उसको अच्छा करने का काम भी यहां है। बुरे का भी यहां यहां कौन सा है?
says: Lifting a person is this house's work, and so is improving agriculture, though it can also do the bad; agriculture and farming fall under the 6th house with Neptune.
ambiguity: The question at the end ('here which sign is it?') starts the next row.

hindi: यहां राहु है। छह नंबर राहु की घर है। यह सूर्य का था। यह छह नंबर राहु का है।
says: Number six belongs to Rahu in his scheme (Virgo sign, 6th house); five was the Sun's, six is Rahu's.
ambiguity: In his 12-planet scheme Virgo is Mercury or Rahu; here he gives it to Rahu, so a Virgo sign with Neptune in the 6th is read through Rahu.
classical_check: Differs: classically Virgo and the 6th are Mercury's; Rahu as Virgo lord is a modern or Nadi-type view.

hindi: राहु का क्या काम है? देखना। राहु क्या है? साक्षी भाव। इतनी दूर तक देख सकता है।
says: Rahu's job is seeing; Rahu is the witness attitude and can see very far.
classical_check: Silent; foresight and detachment are modern attributes of Rahu.

hindi: ऐसा व्यक्ति दारू पिएगा टिकेगी नहीं। एंटीबायोटिक लेगा टिकेगी नहीं।
says: Such a person will drink liquor and it will not stay, and will take an antibiotic and it will not stay; the body rejects both.
ambiguity: Whether it is Neptune in the 6th or Neptune in Virgo is unclear; he says 'sign six' just before.

hindi: लेकिन दूर दृष्टि बहुत होगी। अत्यधिक दूरदृष्टि होती है।
says: But he will have a lot of far-sightedness; Neptune with Rahu's sign gives extreme foresight.

hindi: बोलते बहुत है ऐसे लोग वाणी के बिल्कुल धनी होते हैं।
says: Such people talk a lot and are rich in speech, with a commanding voice.
ambiguity: Virgo is Mercury's sign, so speech fits; the cell assumption follows the previous rows.

hindi: फिर यहीं से बैठ के 12व घर पर दृष्टि है। स्पिरिचुअल ऐसा इंसान किसी ना किसी स्पिरिचुअल गुरु के साथ जुड़ा होता है।
says: From the 6th, Neptune also looks at the 12th house, so such a person is spiritual and linked with some spiritual guru.
cells_derived_method: Neptune in the 6th aspects the 12th by 7th aspect in any sign. The sign of the 6th decides the type of spiritual link: fire signs give charismatic, active gurus; water signs give devotional ones; air signs teaching-based ones.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Neptune in the 6th in Cancer (lagna Aquarius); devotional, mother-like guru connection.
Derived: Neptune in the 6th in Gemini (lagna Capricorn); guru connection through teaching or talks.

classical_check: 7th aspect from 6th to 12th is standard geometry.

hindi: और यह पक्की गारंटी जिस स्पिरिचुअल गुरु के साथ जुड़ा होता है वो उतना ही कमीना भी होता है। यह श्योर शॉट होगा।
says: He says it is guaranteed that the spiritual guru the person is connected with is equally a rogue; he calls this a sure shot (a harsh claim recorded as his).
ambiguity: 'कमीना' is a strong word; the meaning is that the guru has a bad side.

hindi: यानी उसके दो फेस होंगे क्योंकि नेप्च्यून छुपा हुआ देवता है। छुपावट देता है। छुप के पीछे कुछ और निकल सकता है। कोई बड़ी बात नहीं।
says: The guru will have two faces because Neptune is a hidden deity that gives concealment; something else can come out from behind the mask.

hindi: तो ऐसे में बच्चे वो जो होने ना होने बराबर भाई बहन ऐसे जो होने ना होने बराबर बच्चों ने ही ठग लिया मेरी मासी ने ही ठग लिया मेरी नानी ने ही ठग लिया यहां ये भी नानके है हमारे ये मामा ने ही ठग लिया
says: With Neptune in the 6th, children and siblings are as good as absent, and the people who cheat are children, the maternal aunt, the maternal grandmother and the maternal uncle; the maternal side is the 6th's family.
ambiguity: 'यहां ये भी नानके' says maternal family belongs to this house; the sentence is run-on.
classical_check: Agrees that the 6th house relates to the maternal uncle and maternal relatives in many texts.

hindi: होगा उसको उसका शरीर बीमारी रोग होते हैं यहां उसकी बीमारी होती है रोग होते हैं
says: Whoever has Neptune in the 6th gets illness and bodily disease; the 6th house is where disease shows.
ambiguity: Continues the sentence from the previous chunk ('जिसका छठा नेप्च्यून होगा'). A health claim, not a diagnosis.
classical_check: Agrees that the 6th is the house of disease.

hindi: उसके ना कामकाज होता है उसको नौकरी भी ठगी वाली मिलती है रोग भी ठग वाले
says: His work does not run properly, the job he gets is a cheating type and the diseases are deceptive as well; Neptune's deception shows in work and illness.
classical_check: Agrees that the 6th is the house of service and employment.

hindi: यानी रोग ठीक भी तो होना चाहिए तो यह सिर्फ अल्टरनेट थेरेपी से ठीक होते हैं यानी परहेज कर लो।
says: These diseases get cured only with alternative therapy, meaning restraint or abstinence from things; his claim, not medical advice.
ambiguity: 'परहेज' means dietary restraint or avoidance.

hindi: दवाइयां मत खाओ। दवाइयां कम खाओगे ठीक रहोगे। ज्यादा खाओगे और बीमार पड़ोगे।
says: Do not take medicines; if you take fewer you will stay well, and if you take more you will fall sicker; this is his tradition view about the 6th-house Neptune and is not medical advice.
ambiguity: Do not follow as health advice; recorded as his statement.

hindi: क्योंकि एंटीबायोटिक रेजिस्टेंस यही होती है।
says: He gives the reason: this is exactly what antibiotic resistance is, and the 6th-house Neptune gives it.

hindi: यही पेंसिलिन की भी शुरुआत हुई है। छह नंबर के राशि का जब यह रहा है तभी पेंसिलिन धरती पर आई थी।
says: Penicillin began when Neptune was in sign number 6 (Virgo); the discovery of penicillin on earth fell in that period.
ambiguity: Sign-6 assumed to be Virgo. Which zodiac he uses is unclear: Neptune was in Virgo in the tropical zodiac around 1928 (penicillin year), but in the sidereal zodiac of that year it was in Leo.
classical_check: Silent; a historical correlation of his own.

hindi: इसी दौरान में एंटीबायोटिक्स का आविष्कार भी हुआ है क्योंकि आविष्कार कराता है।
says: Antibiotics were also invented in this same period because Neptune makes inventions happen.

hindi: सातवां जो है इसके पास पार्टनरशिप है। बिज़नेस पार्टनरशिप आपका अपना पार्टनर।

hindi: सातवें घर का नेप्च्यून किसी का होता है तो शादी वो है जो है ही नहीं।
says: If Neptune is in someone's 7th house, the marriage is one that does not really exist, a marriage in name only or not a regular marriage.

Derived: Neptune in the 7th in Aquarius (lagna Leo); air sign, an unconventional partnership outside normal marriage.
Derived: Neptune in the 7th in Taurus (lagna Scorpio); earth and Venus sign, the bond may exist for comfort or money while real union is absent.

hindi: ये इसकी मजेदार है बात बहुत तगड़ी। यहां सब सप्तम भाव में नेप्च्यून हो जाए तो ऐसे लड़के या लड़की को अपने पार्टनर के अफेयर का पता होता है। और वो उसे एक्सेप्ट कर लेता है।
says: A funny, strong point: with Neptune in the 7th, the boy or girl knows about the partner's affair and accepts it.

hindi: कैसी अजीब बात है। समुद्र सब कुछ एक्सेप्ट करता है। जहांजहां नेप्च्यून बैठा है वहां वहां एक्सेप्ट करेगा।
says: General principle: the sea accepts everything, so in whichever house Neptune sits, the person accepts the deception coming from that house's relations.
cells_derived_method: The accept-the-betrayal rule applies house by house: the 3rd gives accepted sibling cheating, the 4th mother's side, the 5th children, the 6th enemies and the 7th the partner.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Neptune in the 3rd in Gemini (lagna Aries); sibling cheating is accepted quietly.
Derived: Neptune in the 7th in Pisces (lagna Virgo); partner's deception is accepted.

hindi: यहां बच्चे ठगेंगे जरूर एक्सेप्ट करेगा। यहां शत्रु ही ठगे जाएंगे वो उसको भी एक्सेप्ट करेगा।
says: With Neptune in the 5th, children cheat and he accepts it; with Neptune in the 6th, even enemies get cheated and he accepts that as well.

hindi: तो यहां पार्टनर ठग रहा है और आप उसे एक्सेप्ट कर लोगे।

hindi: तलाक ले भी सकते हैं, तलाक ले लेंगे तो भी आपको बाहर रिलेशन करना है।
says: Divorce is still possible, and even after a divorce the person will seek relationships outside.

hindi: यह वो ग्रह है जो सेक्स के लिए बाहर भेजता है और प्रेम के लिए कहीं और तो अगर आप शादी नहीं करेंगे तो लिव इन रिलेशनशिप में दोनों चीज साथ देगा ये।
says: Neptune is the planet that sends you out for sex and elsewhere for love; if you do not marry, a live-in relationship will give both together.

hindi: मैरिज कर देने मात्र से इस चीज को खत्म करके स्वाहा करता है।

hindi: पार्टनरशिप ऐसी होगी जो लिखावट वाली ना हो। एक तो लिख के पार्टनर है। मिस्टर ए एंड मिस्टर बी आर पार्टनर्स। टूट गई। अगर बुरा है तो तोड़ देगा।

hindi: यह ऑटोमेटिकली ऐसी स्थिति करेगा कि लिखावट की पार्टनरशिप नहीं है। बोलने में चल रही है। सालों साल से चल रही है। बढ़िया चल रही है। तो वो लिव इन रिलेशन जैसी स्थिति है।
says: Neptune automatically creates a partnership that is not in writing but runs on word for years and runs well; this is like a live-in relationship in business.

hindi: ऐसी पार्टनरशिप बिनेस की जिसमें लिखा हुआ नहीं है। चेक ले लिए मैंने भाई से पैसे देके। भाई पैसे खा जाएगा। आपने चेक नहीं लिया। ऐसे ही रखे हुए हैं। कभी नहीं खाएगा।

says: This kind of trust-based relationship forms inside the 7th-house Neptune person, and such a man has a very large heart.

hindi: ऐसे अगर मान लो लड़का हो या लड़की जब वो शादी करती है तो उसके पार्टनर का रिलेशनशिप कहीं बाहर जरूर होता है और वो व्यक्ति बाद की डेट में स्पिरिचुअल गुरु बन जाता है।

says: Otherwise the lightning could destroy anyone; Indra comes looking for Varuna because only near him can he become calm.

hindi: तो ये परम मित्र है। लेकिन यहां पर क्या रूप है इसका? भयावह क्योंकि आग पानी में जा रही है। भयानक ये हनुमान जी का है।

says: The fire is in the navel and belly, while this other place is water; water finally puts out or suppresses fire, which is what Neptune does to the 8th house's fire.

says: With Neptune in the 8th, obscenity, filth, sexual experimentation, negativity, dirt, illegal sex and birth-control pills all get activated automatically.
