hindi: इस जगह पर वो है जो है ही नहीं।
says: In this place stands that which does not exist; with Neptune in the 8th the things of this house are unreal or illusory.

hindi: जैसे ये वो कौन सा पति है सातवें घर में जो है ही नहीं। बच्चा कौन सा है जो है ही नहीं। रिश्तेदार कौन से दूसरे घर के जो है ही नहीं। काम पे लाभ ही नहीं आते। भाई बहन कौन से जो है ही नहीं।
says: A recap of the same pattern house by house: the husband of the 7th who does not exist, the child of the 5th, the relatives of the 2nd, no gain at work, and the siblings of the 3rd; each house's relation is present only on paper.
cells_derived_method: The recap shows the one idea of Neptune making a house's people 'not there'; in each house the relation affected changes: 2nd family, 3rd siblings, 5th children, 7th partner.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Neptune in the 2nd in Taurus (lagna Aries); relatives of the family are unreliable.
Derived: Neptune in the 5th in Scorpio (lagna Cancer); the child relationship is hidden or absent.
Derived: Neptune in the 7th in Aries (lagna Libra); a partner who is there in name but absent in practice.

ambiguity: 'काम पे लाभ ही नहीं आते' has no house named; it probably refers to the 10th or 11th.

hindi: तो आठवें घर में क्या बनेगा? ससुराल जो है ही नहीं।
says: In the 8th house the in-laws' family will be the one that does not really exist; the 8th is the house of the in-laws, and Neptune makes it unreal.
classical_check: Agrees that the 8th relates to the spouse's family (second house from the 7th); Neptune part is his own.

hindi: तो एक ऐसा इललीगल ससुराल मिलेगा। इललीगल शादी मिल सकती है। लीगल
says: An irregular, illegitimate in-law family will be found, and an irregular marriage is possible; the sentence continues with the case of a legal marriage.
ambiguity: 'इललीगल' may mean illegitimate or informal rather than unlawful.

hindi: शादी मिलेगी तो उस लड़की के माता-पिता में से हो सकता है उसको गोद लिया हो या हो सकता है वो माता-पिता से बहुत ही दूर रहती हो।
says: If a legal marriage happens, the girl may have been adopted by her parents or may live very far from them; the in-law side is still unusual.
ambiguity: The sentence begins in the previous chunk ('लीगल शादी मिलेगी तो...').

hindi: ये कौन-कौन से पैसे हैं? ये वो पैसे हैं जो क्रेडिट कार्ड के पैसे हैं जो है ही नहीं।
says: The money of the 8th with Neptune is credit-card money, which is not actually yours, borrowed money that does not exist as real wealth.
classical_check: Agrees that the 8th covers debt and others' money.

hindi: आपके नाम कोई बिल करके चला गया है। पर जब आप कोर्ट केस में जाते हो तो आपको बिल मिलते ही नहीं। आप बिल को प्रूव ही नहीं कर पाते।
says: Someone has billed you and left, but when you go to court the bills cannot be found and you cannot prove them; legal and paperwork trouble with unreal dues.
ambiguity: The sense is that you cannot prove bills in your favour or against; direction is not clear.

hindi: आपके पास पैसा है। किसी ने कह दिया तेरे को ₹1 करोड़ दे दिया। वो जिंदगी में आपके हाथ नहीं आता।
says: Money exists on paper; someone says he has given you one crore, but it never reaches your hand in life.
ambiguity: A statement about promised money in the 8th, not investment advice.

hindi: यानी कि वो वो चीजें जो है ही नहीं। तो समुद्र का क्या है? अंत है ही नहीं।
says: All these are things that do not exist, and the sea has no end, so in the 8th the promised things have no limit either.

hindi: और अगर आपका नेप्च्यून यहां पॉजिटिव आपने कर लिया कैसे? विशाल हृदय करके आपका जो नहीं है वह भी मिलेगा।
says: Remedy: if you make your Neptune positive here by having a large heart, you will get even what is not yours.

hindi: आपके बैंक लोन सारे यहां पर है। आप 24 घंटे पिट रहे हैं बैंक लोन कैसे देंगे? कौन देगा?
says: All your bank loans belong to the 8th, and you are anxious all day about how and who will repay them.
classical_check: Agrees that debts and loans are 8th-house topics.

hindi: बोला नहीं दिए जाएंगे तो नहीं देंगे भाई। डंडे खा लेंगे दिए जाएंगे दे देंगे। कितना सिंपल है। आपका नेप्च्यून लाइट हो जाएगा।
says: The relaxed attitude: if it cannot be paid, it will not be paid, and you take the stick; if it can be paid, you pay; it is simple, and your Neptune becomes light. This is a mindset remedy, not financial advice.
ambiguity: A statement about attitude to debt; do not read as advice to default.

hindi: ये सिर्फ आपकी एक सोच की ट्विस्ट। इदा नाड़ी काम कर रही है या पिंगला नाड़ी? तो नेप्च्यून आपको अपने आप ये चीज करके दे देगा।
says: It is only a twist of thought; ask which nostril channel, ida or pingala, is working, and then Neptune will automatically deliver this to you.
ambiguity: The link between ida/pingala nadi and Neptune's gifts is not explained.
classical_check: Silent; nadi breath work is yogic, not astrological.

hindi: इसके लिए आपके सारे वो धन जो नकली है जो हुए नहीं है। रुकी हुई पेंशन क्रेडिट कार्ड के लोनस आपकी विल आपको यहां से पैसा आने वाला है। आता है नहीं बातें होती रहती है।
says: The 8th-house Neptune covers fake wealth that has not really come: stuck pension, credit card loans and your will; money is always said to be coming, but it does not arrive, only talk continues.
ambiguity: Recorded as house themes; not financial advice.
classical_check: Agrees that inheritance, wills and pensions fall under the 8th.

hindi: नाइंथ हाउस ये बृहस्पति का होता है। बृहस्पति राय देवता यहां है।
says: The 9th house belongs to Jupiter; Jupiter, the adviser deity, is its lord.
ambiguity: 'राय देवता' means the deity of advice; the sign of number 9 is Sagittarius.
classical_check: Agrees: Jupiter is natural lord of the 9th and Sagittarius.

hindi: यह हमारा जल चक्र है सारा। सेक्स चक्र है नौ और 12।
says: Houses nine and twelve together form the water chakra, which he also calls the sex chakra.
ambiguity: 'नौ और 12' could be houses or signs; both coincide with Jupiter's signs, Sagittarius and Pisces.
classical_check: Silent; chakra mapping is his own.

hindi: तो नौ और 12 दोनों में लाजवाब है।
says: Neptune is excellent in both the 9th and the 12th.
cells_derived_method: Both houses take Neptune well (water, spiritual); the sign refines it: Sagittarius and Pisces (Jupiter's signs) are best, fire or earth signs less so.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Neptune in the 9th in Pisces (lagna Cancer); strong mystic faith and wisdom.
Derived: Neptune in the 12th in Pisces (lagna Aries); deep meditation, sleep and foreign links.
Derived: Neptune in the 12th in Taurus (lagna Gemini); more pleasure-based, still positive.

hindi: 12 नंबर केतु का हो गया। केतु को पानी देता कौन है? देता ही समुद्र है।
says: Number twelve is Ketu's, and it is the sea that gives water to Ketu; Neptune nourishes Ketu.
ambiguity: In his scheme Pisces is Jupiter or Ketu; here he gives it to Ketu.
classical_check: Differs: Pisces is Jupiter's classically; Ketu as co-lord is a modern view.

hindi: समुद्र से पानी उठता है। बादल ले जाते हैं और आगे उर्वरक कर देते हैं। मंगल का भी भला कर देते हैं। चंद्रमा गिरता है। शुक्र क्रिएट हो जाता है।
says: Water rises from the sea, clouds carry it ahead and make the land fertile; it also does good to Mars, the Moon falls into it and Venus is created from it; Neptune feeds other planets.
ambiguity: 'चंद्रमा गिरता है' is unclear; it may refer to the Moon's reflection or myth. Venus born from the sea is a Greek-style myth.
classical_check: Silent; Moon from the sea is an Indian churning-of-the-ocean myth, Venus is Aphrodite's.

hindi: नौ नंबर बृहस्पति महाराज तो गुरु है। यहां जिसका नेप्च्यून बैठा हुआ है वो व्यक्ति धर्म की अवधारणाएं तोड़ देता है।
says: Number nine is Jupiter, the teacher; a person with Neptune sitting in the 9th breaks the ideas and conventions of religion.
cells_derived_method: The religion-breaking effect depends on the sign of the 9th: fire signs make an open rebel, air signs an intellectual critic, water signs a mystic who dissolves forms, earth signs a reformer of rituals.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Neptune in the 9th in Aries (lagna Leo); an open rebel against religion.
Derived: Neptune in the 9th in Aquarius (lagna Gemini); a reformer who replaces old doctrines with new ideas.
Derived: Neptune in the 9th in Cancer (lagna Scorpio); a mystic who feels religion without a form.

hindi: यानी वो एक नए धर्म को मानना शुरू करता है। उसके अंदर अपना ही एक स्टाइल अपनी ही तसल्ली होती है।
says: He starts following a new religion or path; he has his own style and his own sense of satisfaction.

hindi: क्योंकि लिमिटेशन नहीं जबरदस्त स्पिरिचुअल दारू इत्यादि का भाड़ में 1% नहीं।
says: Because Neptune has no limits here, the person is strongly spiritual, and liquor and similar vices count for not even one percent; the result is spirituality instead of addiction.
ambiguity: Caption is partly garbled; meaning is inferred from the next sentence.

hindi: यहां पर है जो व्यक्ति दवाइयों से भी पकड़ के चलता है, शराब से भी पकड़ के चलता है, सिगरेट से भी। तो किसी किस्म की अय्याशी यहां कराना कठिन है।
says: The person here keeps himself restrained from medicines, liquor and cigarettes, so any kind of debauchery is hard for this placement.
ambiguity: 'पकड़ के चलता है' could mean 'holds himself tightly (restrained)' or 'keeps a firm grip on'; read as restraint.

hindi: अब यहां पॉइंट समझे। नौ नौवें घर में बृहस्प बैठ गया नेप्च्यून। अगर नौ नंबर का नेप्च्यून कुंडली में कहीं भी बैठ गया तो
says: The key point: Neptune of the 9th, in Jupiter's place, or Neptune of sign number nine placed anywhere in the chart, has a special effect, which the next sentence completes.
cells_derived_method: Neptune in Sagittarius in any house carries the Jupiter-ruled effect with it: in the 1st it shapes the self, in the 4th the home, in the 10th the career.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Neptune in Sagittarius in the 1st (lagna Sagittarius); the person himself becomes a moral preacher type.
Derived: Neptune in Sagittarius in the 4th (lagna Virgo); home life is disciplined and spiritual.
Derived: Neptune in Sagittarius in the 10th (lagna Pisces); career in teaching or religion.

ambiguity: 'नौ नंबर का नेप्च्यून' may mean Neptune in the 9th house or in sign 9; both forms are listed.

hindi: भी वो इतना सशक्त है कि औरों के भी ऐब छुड़ा दे।
says: Even sitting anywhere, such a 9th Neptune is so powerful that it can make other people give up their vices.
ambiguity: The sentence begins at the end of the previous chunk ('...कहीं भी बैठ गया तो भी').

hindi: अब ऐसे व्यक्ति का क्या हाल है? यह पांचवा घर है। यह चौथा घर था। व्यक्ति खुद ही मां समान है। यानी अपने बच्चों की ऐसी केयर करेगा जैसे मां समान मिलेंगे डंडे चाय।
says: Summary of the person's role house by house: in the 4th he is himself like a mother and cares for his children as a mother would; Neptune makes the person become the relation of the house.
cells_derived_method: The idea that the person turns into the house's relative applies to each house; the sign decides how the role shows.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Neptune in the 4th in Cancer (lagna Aries); strongest mother-like role.
Derived: Neptune in the 4th in Capricorn (lagna Libra); a strict, duty-bound mother-like caretaker.

ambiguity: 'मिलेंगे डंडे चाय' is garbled; read as the mother-like care that gives both stick and tea.

hindi: बच्चा पांचव घर का नेप्च्यून अपने बच्चे काम नहीं है लेकिन खुद ही बच्चे समान है।
says: For Neptune in the 5th, his own children are not much use to him, but he himself is like a child.

hindi: ये छठा एंटीबायोटिक रेजिस्टेंस अपनी खुद की शत्रु समान है।
says: For Neptune in the 6th, with antibiotic resistance, the person is his own enemy; his body or habits work against himself.

hindi: सातवां अपनी पत्नी का पति उसके लिए लवर के समान है।
says: For Neptune in the 7th, a husband is a lover to his wife, not a conventional spouse.

hindi: ऑटोमेटिक यह पापा का स्थान है। इसका पिता अल्कोहलिक हो सकता है। या तो व्यक्ति का जिसकी कुंडली में या वो खुद ही सबका पिता होगा।
says: The 9th is automatically the father's place; with Neptune there, the father can be an alcoholic, or else the person himself becomes the father of everyone.
cells_derived_method: The father's trait follows the sign: water signs (Cancer, Scorpio) lean to alcoholic or emotional fathers, Sagittarius or Pisces to spiritual ones, earth signs to strict and absent ones.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Neptune in the 9th in Scorpio (lagna Pisces); father with secret or alcohol habits.
Derived: Neptune in the 9th in Sagittarius (lagna Aries); father spiritual or principled.

ambiguity: This conflicts a little with the earlier claim that the 9th Neptune person himself avoids alcohol; here it is the father who may be alcoholic.
classical_check: Agrees that the 9th house is the father's house in many traditions (Parashari takes the 9th for the father).

hindi: यानी उसको जगत पापा कह सकते हैं। वह सारी दुनिया का ध्यान रखने में लगा हुआ है कि हां हां मुझे काम बताओ यार मैं करके देता हूं। तुम्हें काम की क्या है? मैं करके दूंगा।
says: He can be called the father of the world: he is busy looking after everyone, saying 'tell me the work, I will do it for you'.

hindi: बस उस व्यक्ति को बाप बनाना पड़ेगा। पर वो इतने पक्के उसूल का होगा कि उसके उसूल नहीं तोड़ सकता कोई बखशेगा नहीं।
says: You only have to make that person the father figure; but he will have such firm principles that nobody can break them and he will spare no one who does.

hindi: क्योंकि बृहस्पति के यहां जाके जबरदस्त व्यवस्थित हो जाता है।
says: The reason for the firm principles: when Neptune goes to Jupiter's place it becomes powerfully organised and ordered.

hindi: बृहस्पति का सीधा सा खेल है।
says: Jupiter's style is simple and rule-bound: it runs the native's life by discipline, not by indulgence.
classical_check: Classical texts call Jupiter dharma, guru and discipline; consistent in spirit, but the Covid-circle imagery is his own.

hindi: जो भी आएगा तमीज से रहेगा भाई।
says: Anyone who comes into Jupiter's company or influence is expected to behave with decorum and manners.
classical_check: Silent on this wording; consistent with Jupiter as the upholder of propriety.

hindi: यानी बृहस्पति के महफिल के अंदर कोई फालतू डांस नहीं कर सकता।
says: Inside Jupiter's gathering no frivolous or undisciplined behaviour is tolerated: Jupiter enforces propriety in whatever area it rules.

hindi: एक घेरा बना दिया जाएगा कोविड का कि इसी घेरे में खड़े होना है।
says: Using a Covid-lockdown picture, he says Jupiter draws a fixed circle and everyone must stand inside it: a boundary of rules.
classical_check: Silent; the circle is his analogy (like a lakshman-rekha).

hindi: इस घोरे के बाहर आप गए तो पड़ेंगे डंडे।
says: Anyone who steps outside Jupiter's circle gets punished (beaten with sticks): breaking Jupiter's rules brings strict correction.
classical_check: Silent; contrasts with the usual soft, benefic image of Jupiter.

hindi: इसलिए जुपिटर पकड़ के चलता है।
says: Because of this, Jupiter 'holds on' to the person: it keeps the native gripped within principles (Jupiter is a restraining, controlling influence).
ambiguity: 'पकड़ के चलता है' could mean Jupiter grips people or Jupiter itself moves holding to rules.

hindi: जुपिटर सबसे बड़ा ग्रह है।
says: Jupiter is the biggest planet (physical size); he uses this to justify its authority.
classical_check: True astronomically for the classical set; classical texts call Jupiter 'brihat' (great).

gist: Fragment 'bigger than this too': the referent is not clear from the caption (possibly Neptune or another outer planet).

hindi: इस नवम भाव में परोपकारी होता है ऐसा व्यक्ति।
says: Jupiter in the 9th house (its natural house) makes the person philanthropic.
cells_derived_method: Jupiter's giving nature shows through the 9th (dharma, charity, gurus). The sign decides the style: own sign Sagittarius gives organised dharma-giving, exalted Cancer gives nurturing charity, debilitated Capricorn gives dutiful but resource-limited giving.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Jupiter in own sign in 9th (Aries lagna): charity through temples, teaching and guru institutions.
Derived: exalted Jupiter in 9th (Scorpio lagna): giving that is emotional and family- or mother-linked, trust funds and food charity.
Derived: debilitated Jupiter in 9th (Taurus lagna): intent to give is there but giving is limited by duty and scarcity, structured and slow.

ambiguity: 'नवम भाव' could be the 9th house or the 9th sign Sagittarius; he may be pointing at the wheel.
classical_check: BPHS gives Jupiter in the 9th as charitable and dharmic; agrees.

hindi: ऐसे व्यक्ति जो है एनजीओस खोल लेते हैं।
says: Such people start NGOs (their philanthropy turns into setting up organisations).
cells_derived_method: Philanthropy channel depends on the sign: air and water signs lean to social causes, fire signs to religious or teaching trusts. Derived only.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Jupiter in Libra in 9th (Aquarius lagna: 7-9+1=-1 -> 11): NGO work around justice, fairness and legal aid.
Derived: Jupiter in Pisces in 9th (lagna 12-9+1=4 Cancer): charitable and spiritual NGOs, healing or ashram type.

ambiguity: Same 9th-house vs Sagittarius ambiguity.
classical_check: Silent on NGOs (modern form of charity); consistent with 9th as dharma.

hindi: ऐसे व्यक्ति जो है एनजीओस के लिए काम कर देते हैं।
says: Others of this type do not found NGOs but work for NGOs; the giving shows as service in someone else's organisation.
cells_derived_method: Founder versus worker depends on the 10th lord and Sun/Mars strength: derived, not stated.

hindi: ऐसे लोग कमर्शियल काम भी करते हैं।
says: These people also do commercial work; they are not only charity workers.
classical_check: Silent; Jupiter is also the karaka of wealth, so earning is consistent.

hindi: खूब कमाते हैं और देते हैं।
says: They earn a lot and give it away; high income paired with high giving.
cells_derived_method: Jupiter karaka of wealth plus 9th (fortune) gives earning; giving shows as spending from 2nd/11th into 12th. Derived.
classical_check: Consistent with Jupiter as dhana karaka and 9th as luck.

hindi: ऐसे लोग रॉबिन होते हैं।
says: Such natives are like Robin Hood: they take money from one place and give to another.

hindi: इससे पैसा लिया उसको दिया।
says: The mechanism: money is taken from one person and passed to another person; they act as a conduit rather than keeping it.

gist: Rhetorical question: what do they do for themselves?

hindi: कुछ नहीं।
says: The answer: they do nothing for themselves; they keep nothing for personal comfort (a self-denying giver).
classical_check: Silent; contradicts the usual notion that a strong Jupiter brings personal wealth.

hindi: खाली प्लेट खाती है तो बहुत सामाजिक होते हैं।
says: Caption garbled around 'empty plate'; the clear part says these people are very social. He likely means they live simply, eating from an empty plate, while being very sociable.
ambiguity: 'खाली प्लेट खाती है' is not grammatical; the exact image is uncertain.

hindi: बहुत प्रेम वाले होते हैं।
says: They are very loving people.
classical_check: Silent; consistent with Jupiter as benefic.

hindi: लेकिन उसूल वाले बृहस्पति उसूल से चलता है।
says: But they are principled: Jupiter works by principles (usool), so love is conditional on rules being kept.
classical_check: Consistent with Jupiter as dharma and law-giver.

hindi: बृहस्पति एक खतरनाक गुरु है।
says: Jupiter is a dangerous guru: not the soft teacher image of popular astrology.
classical_check: Differs from common benefic image; classical texts do not call Jupiter dangerous.

hindi: ऐसी स्थिति के अंदर मृत्यु का देवता यमराज भयंकर प्रसन्न होता है कि वरुण देवता आए हैं आपके पंजों के साथ
says: In this combination Yama (Pluto) is greatly pleased that Varuna (Neptune) has come along with him.
ambiguity: 'पंजों' unclear; likely Neptune placed next to Pluto.

hindi: यहां पर यमराज है यहां वरुण है साथ में ही है पॉजिटिव है तो दोनों साथ-साथ भाई भाई है एक तरह से
says: Pluto here and Neptune here sit next to each other; when positive, they work together like brothers.

hindi: यमराज के पास नर्क है यहां नर्क नर्क में ट्रांसफर करता है ना लोगों को ये यमराज के तुम तो नर्क में जाओ फिर यहां भेजता है स्वर्ग में जाओ
says: Yamraj (Pluto) owns hell: he transfers people to hell and then, from his side, sends them on to heaven: Pluto controls the destination after death in the myth.

hindi: तो नर्क और स्वर्ग इसलिए बड़े प्रेम से यह कहता है यमराज आ जाओ यार कोई प्रॉब्लम नहीं है मेरे को
says: Because Yama deals with both hell and heaven, he is easy and affectionate: a Pluto person says 'come along, no problem for me', being unbothered by either outcome.
ambiguity: Caption is run-on; the quote may be Pluto speaking to Neptune.

hindi: उसके पश्चात है 12 नंबर।
says: After Pluto (11) comes number 12 (the next place on the wheel).
ambiguity: Could be 12th house or 12th sign Pisces.

hindi: यह केतु की राशि है।
says: This (the 12th place, Pisces) is Ketu's sign in his scheme.
ambiguity: In his scheme Pisces has Jupiter or Ketu; here Ketu named.

hindi: केतु भी यहां पर आपका है 12 नंबर।

hindi: यह भी हमारा जल चक्र है।

hindi: यह भूमि चक्र है।

hindi: जल चक्र है।

hindi: अग्नि चक्र है।

ambiguity: Pointing; house not stated.

hindi: हृदय चक्र हवा का वायु का और ये स्पेस एलिमेंट है।
says: The heart chakra is of air (vayu) and this one is the space element: two more places assigned to air and space.
ambiguity: Pointing; house not stated.
classical_check: Elements-chakra-signs mapping is not in Parashari texts.

hindi: यहां पर जितने गुरु स्पिरिचुअल हीलर्स जितने आपके योगा वाले जितने ऑल्टर नेट थेरेपीस वाले बंदे हैं सारे यही हैं।
says: At the 12th (Neptune with Ketu) sit all the gurus, spiritual healers, yoga people and alternative-therapy practitioners.

Derived: Neptune in Scorpio in 12th (Sagittarius lagna: 8-12+1=-3 -> 9): occult and tantra-style healers.

ambiguity: 'यहां' = 12th house or sign Pisces.

hindi: आपके सब के सब यही है आपके।
says: All of them are here; he stresses that all of this group falls in this one place.

hindi: सारे पैरेलल यूनिवर्स की बात करने वाले, अलग डायमेंशंस की बात करने वाले, ज्ञान के अजीब अजीब कहानियां लिखने वाले, पुस्तक लिखने वाले उल्टा यहीं पर भी ढोंगी बाबा ढोंगी जो है बाबा लगे हुए हैं कि अजी हमें फॉलो करो चोगा पहन लिया।
says: The same place also gives parallel-universe talkers, authors of strange knowledge books and fake babas in robes who ask you to follow them.
cells_derived_method: Afflicted Neptune in the 12th turns spirituality into show: sign changes the style.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Neptune in Gemini in 12th (Cancer lagna: 3-12+1=-8 -> 4): influencer-type fake gurus and prolific book-writers.
Derived: Neptune in Aries in 12th (Taurus lagna: 1-12+1=-10 -> 2): aggressive self-promoting babas.

hindi: सब ड्रामेबाजी यहां होती है।
says: All the drama takes place here.

hindi: यहीं से आपको कृपा वाले खर्चे मिलते हैं।
says: From this place you get the expenses that come as 'grace' (kripa): expenses that mysteriously get covered.
cells_derived_method: 12th as expenses is classical: Neptune gives unseen cover for them.
classical_check: 12th as expenses is classical; the grace twist is his.

hindi: यानी खर्चे क्रिएट हो गए और आपने छोड़ दिए।
says: Expenses get created and then you leave them alone (let them go).

hindi: पता नहीं कैसे होंगे।
says: You do not know how they will be paid.

hindi: हो गए।
says: They are paid anyway: they got done.

hindi: हर व्यक्ति का इस संसार में यह समय आता है जब वो कार्य कर रहा है या उसको जरूरत है और वो यह कहता है कि मुझे हर हालत में आज रात मौत होगी कल सुबह पैसे कहां से दूंगा बच्चे की फीस लानी है शादी ब्याह के लिए चाहिए कहीं यात्रा करनी है कल किसी के पैसे चुकाने हैं सो जाता है पता नहीं छोड़ दिया अगले दिन जुगाड़ हो गया आपका जुगाड़ कहां से हुआ अपने आप हो गया
says: Everyone has such a time: need for fees, wedding or travel money tomorrow, he sleeps without a plan, and next day the arrangement happens by itself. He attributes this to Neptune in the 12th.

hindi: यहां पर लोगों के किताबों में झूठे प्रॉफिट होते हैं।
says: People's account books here show false profits: Neptune in the 12th gives inflated or illusory books.

hindi: यहां झूठा खर्चा क्रिएट करते ही पैसा आ जाता है।
says: Creating a false expense here makes money come: pretending a need draws money.

hindi: बंदे ने सिर्फ सोच लिया खर्चा चाहिए केतु की तरह काम करता है ये क्योंकि केतु की राशि में है।
says: The person only thinks 'I need this expense' and it works like Ketu because Neptune is in Ketu's sign.
ambiguity: Sign Pisces taken as Ketu sign.

hindi: इसलिए नेप्च्यून 12व वाला जितने खर्चे बढ़ाता है उतने खर्चे ज्यादा पैसे ज्यादा आ जाते हैं।
says: Neptune in the 12th: the more it raises expenses, the more money comes in.
cells_derived_method: Expense-gain link in the 12th as a Neptune effect; sign flavour derived.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Neptune in Pisces in 12th (Aries lagna): fullest form, money follows spending.
Derived: Neptune in Libra in 12th (Scorpio lagna): money flows from spending on partners and luxury.

hindi: क्योंकि ये केतु की राशि में केतु बृहस्पति साथ चल रहे हैं।
says: Because it is in Ketu's sign, Ketu and Jupiter walk together there (Pisces: Jupiter or Ketu).
classical_check: Pisces is Jupiter-ruled classically; Ketu is his addition.

gist: 'It is one place.'

hindi: वाटर चक्र के पास है।
says: It is near the water chakra.
ambiguity: Same chakra ambiguity as row 4.

hindi: यहीं सेक्सुअल एक्टिविटी भी होती है।
says: Sexual activity also happens here (12th house pleasures).

hindi: संतानों को ढेर लगा देता है ये ऐसी स्थिति में।
says: In this situation Neptune gives a heap of children.
classical_check: Silent; classical 12th is not a children house.

gist: Fragment 'so wherever' (continued).

hindi: नेप्च्यून बैठा है, उस घर में इललीगल रिश्ते को सेट करेगा।
says: Wherever Neptune sits it will set up an illegal or irregular relationship in that house.
cells_derived_method: For each house the matter (father, work, friends...) gets an unconventional relationship: see following rows.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Neptune in 2nd (lagna 2-2+1=1 Aries): irregular dealings in money or family speech.
Derived: Neptune in Leo in 5th (lagna 5-5+1=1 Aries): irregular romance or unusual relationship with children.
Derived: Neptune in Libra in 7th (lagna 7-7+1=1 Aries): informal or illegal marriage.

hindi: यानी नौवें घर का हो गया तो पिता से झगड़ा या खुद ही पिता बन गया
says: If it is in the 9th: fight with father, or the native himself becomes the father figure.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Neptune in Cancer in 9th (Scorpio lagna): father is emotional or absent; native mothers the father.
Derived: Neptune in Sagittarius in 9th (Aries lagna): father is a guru-like or religious figure with a gulf.

classical_check: 9th for father is classical (Parashari uses 9th, Jaimini too).

hindi: 10वें में हो गया तो काम से झगड़ा खुद ही काम बन गया
says: If in the 10th: conflict with work, or the person becomes his own work (self-employed identity).

hindi: 11वें में दोस्तों से झगड़ा या खुद ही का दोस्त बन गया दोस्तों को दारू पिलाई
says: If in the 11th: fights with friends, or becomes his own friend, or treats friends to liquor.

hindi: या ये गुरु गुरु से झगड़ा गुरु भी अपने आप ही बन गया या फिर गुरु के द्वारा ठगे गए
says: Fights with the guru, becomes his own guru, or gets cheated by a guru.
ambiguity: House not stated; guru is normally the 9th, but he is listing houses so could be the 9th again.

says: With Neptune in the lagna: conflict with self and no self-confidence.
ambiguity: House is not named; self implies 1st.

says: In other houses: quarrels with siblings and relatives (3rd), tension with mother, aunts or children (4th and 5th).
ambiguity: Pointing on the wheel; houses assumed 3, 4, 5.

says: Neptune is positive in the 6th (enemies), 8th (death) and 12th (expenses, hospitals): in the dusthanas it works well.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Neptune in Libra in 6th (lagna 7-6+1=2 Taurus): enemies dissolve; disputes settle quietly.
Derived: Neptune in Pisces in 8th (lagna 12-8+1=5 Leo): smooth, mystic experience around transformation.
Derived: Neptune in Taurus in 12th (lagna 2-12+1=-9 -> 3 Gemini): spending is eased and well covered.

ambiguity: Houses 6, 8, 12 inferred from topics named (enemies, death, expenses).
classical_check: Classically dusthana planets weaken the house's matters; his reading is different.

hindi: जहां यह पड़े नहीं वहीं जीते आपकी।
says: Garbled: 'where it does not fall, there you win': probably the houses Neptune does not occupy give wins.
ambiguity: Caption garbled.

hindi: यह ऑटोमेटिकली प्लस करता है।
says: It automatically adds a plus: Neptune's presence is claimed to boost whichever area it touches.
ambiguity: 'ऑटोमेटिकली प्लस' unclear.

hindi: तो समुद्र जहांजहां जा रहा है वहां वहां वैसा-वैसा काम करेगा।
says: The sea goes wherever it goes and does that sort of work: Neptune takes the nature of the sign and house it falls in.
cells_derived_method: Reading depends on sign nature and house topic: Neptune shape-shifts.

Derived: Neptune in Scorpio in 8th (lagna 8-8+1=1 Aries): occult research, hidden inheritances.

hindi: समुद्र शुक्र के साथ है।
says: Neptune is with Venus (the sea with Venus: either conjunct or in Venus's sign).
ambiguity: 'शुक्र के साथ' could mean conjunction or in Venus's signs; the next lines speak of signs.

hindi: शुक्र की राशि में लाजवाब होगा।
says: In Venus's sign Neptune will be excellent.
cells_derived_method: House topics decide what improves: derived.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Neptune in Libra in 7th (Aries lagna): refined partnerships and art.
Derived: Neptune in Taurus in 2nd (Aries lagna): speech and finances with aesthetic or artistic bent.

hindi: इन दोनों राशियों में नेगेटिव होगा।
says: In these two signs (pointing, unnamed) Neptune will be negative.
ambiguity: The two signs are not named; he points at the wheel.

says: Fragment: positive here (sign not named). Continues in next caption chunk with 'will be'.

hindi: होगा।

hindi: इसमें पॉजिटिव होगा।

says: A further sign (unnamed): neutral for Neptune.

says: One more sign (unnamed): minus for Neptune.
ambiguity: Sign pointed, not named.

says: This is the Neptune placement with the Moon: introduces Neptune with Moon as the case being discussed.
ambiguity: 'with Moon' could mean conjunction or in Cancer.

hindi: इसकी टेंशन इसलिए नहीं है क्योंकि 14 साल एक ही राशि में रहता है।
says: No tension in the sign position because Neptune stays 14 years in one sign (generational), so the house matters more than the sign for personal results.
classical_check: Neptune takes about 14 years per sign; true. Classical texts do not use Neptune.

hindi: बहुत लंबे समय रहता है।
says: It stays a very long time in one sign.

hindi: अब इसकी जो राशि सात नंबर है।
says: Now its sign, number 7 (Libra) is discussed as a Neptune sign in his scheme.
ambiguity: Neptune in Libra or ruling Libra.

hindi: समुद्र में जब और ग्रह आते हैं तो उनका एक डिफरेंट फल चलता है।
says: When other planets enter the 'sea' (Neptune's sign), they give a different result.

hindi: सात नंबर राशि में सूर्य आता है।

hindi: सूर्य नीच का होता है।
says: The Sun is debilitated there.

hindi: यहां बिल्कुल तबाही का फल।
says: Result: complete devastation (tabahi) of what the Sun stands for.

says: Sun is the third eye; if it begins to follow the heart's voice (heart is mad), the third eye is lost.

says: Vision (insight) is blocked: the clear sight of a strong Sun is lost in the Libra heart state.

hindi: अगर आपने आग के गोले सूरज को समुद्र में डाला है तो समुद्र को भक के खत्म कर देगा धरती पे तो समुद्र सबसे बड़ा है लेकिन हजारों धरती आ सकती है एक सूर्य में
says: Analogy: dropping the fireball Sun into the sea (Neptune) would boil it away: the sea is the biggest on earth, but thousands of earths fit in one Sun.

hindi: सूर्य इतना ज्यादा बड़ा है और सूर्य जीवन दाता है तो सूर्य जैसे देवता को सात नंबर में आना इज़ नॉट गुड
says: Because the Sun is the giver of life, such a deity coming into sign 7 (Libra) is not good.
cells_derived_method: Same as debilitation: effect by house topic.

Derived: Sun in Libra in 5th (lagna 7-5+1=3 Gemini): children and intelligence diminished.

hindi: सात नंबर का सूर्य हार्ट अटैक देता है
says: He claims Sun in sign 7 gives heart attack. Flagged: this is a medical claim that this system does not endorse.
cells_derived_method: Heart is Leo/Sun's domain: debilitated Sun in Libra read as heart weakness by him.

hindi: हां जी सात नंबर वाले दिल से ही सोचते हैं।

ambiguity: Next row says they do not think from the heart (caption 'नहीं' vs 'ही').

hindi: सात नंबर राशि वाले दिल के नहीं सोचते सात नंबर सात नंबर राशि में क्या बैठा है कुंडली में वैसा वाला दिल में है।

cells_derived_method: Planet in Libra defines the heart's content: Moon would make heart emotional, Saturn controlled.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Moon in Libra in 1st (Libra lagna): heart is sensitive to others' approval.
Derived: Saturn in Libra in 4th (Cancer lagna): heart restrained, mother-linked duty.

ambiguity: Contradiction: 'दिल के नहीं सोचते' versus 'दिल से ही सोचते हैं' in previous row.

hindi: अगर आपका चार नंबर राशि यहां बैठी है।
says: Example: if sign number 4 (Cancer) sits in the house you want to activate.
ambiguity: 'चार नंबर' taken as Cancer.

hindi: मान लो चंद्रमा यहां चार नंबर का है।
says: Say the Moon is here, as lord of sign 4.
classical_check: Moon as lord of Cancer is classical.

hindi: चार नंबर का चंद्रमा है और चंद्रमा यहां यहां या यहां से लिंक्ड है।
says: Sign 4's lord Moon is linked to this place or that place (position or aspect).

hindi: तो पहले तो मोती पहनो।
says: First wear a pearl (remedy for the lord Moon).

hindi: फिर यहां जो बैठा है उसको बाद में करो।
says: Then do the remedy for the planet sitting there afterwards.

hindi: सबसे पहले जो राशि घर चार नंबर जिसका मालिक है कहां?
says: First step of the remedy workflow: identify the lord of the sign sitting on the 4th house and find which house and sign that lord occupies in the chart.
cells_derived_method: The 4th-house lord changes with lagna (4th sign from lagna) and its result changes with the house it occupies: in kendra/trikona it supports home, mother, comfort; in 6/8/12 it strains them. Sign nature of the lord's position (own, friend, enemy) adds to this.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Aries lagna, 4th sign Cancer, lord Moon sits in the 10th (Capricorn); home and mother matters are tied to career and public life.
Derived: Libra lagna, 4th sign Capricorn, lord Saturn in the 12th (Virgo); home comforts go to expense or foreign residence, with a loss tone.
Derived: Leo lagna, 4th sign Scorpio, lord Mars in the 8th (Pisces); property and peace of mind get sudden changes.

ambiguity: Caption says 'राशि घर चार नंबर' - could mean the 4th house sign or the 4th sign (Cancer); taken as 4th house.
classical_check: Agrees: reading any bhava through its lord's placement is standard in Parashari method.

hindi: इस घर के मालिक को तो जगाओ।
says: Remedy principle: the lord of the weak or afflicted house must be activated (strengthened) first, before anything else is done for that house.
ambiguity: 'Wake up' is not defined here; the method of waking is promised for the next class.
classical_check: Silent on the wording, but strengthening the house lord is a common remedial idea.

gist: Analogy of visiting uncle's house while annoyed with him but knowing he is in the next room, so you break nothing; used to illustrate a lord sitting nearby.

hindi: फिर उसके बाद वक्रत्व भी चेक करेंगे
says: After locating the house lord, also check whether that planet is retrograde (vakri), as it modifies the result and the remedy.
classical_check: Agrees: retrograde planets are given cheshtabala (motional strength) in Parashari texts.

hindi: हां फिर वक्रत्व चेक होगा फिर वक्री के उपाय 101% करने
says: If the lord is retrograde, the retrograde-specific remedies must be done fully (he stresses '101%'), after the retrograde check is complete.
ambiguity: The specific retrograde remedies are not given in this slice.
classical_check: Silent: classical texts do not give a separate remedy set for retrograde planets.

gist: Student asks how to do the remedies and jokes that the instructor has added two more classes.
Instructor jokes that he planned two months, made it three, and will keep extending.
Reply that it will be done in the next class and instructor agrees to do remedies next time.

Joke about whether the student paid charges for an out-of-topic answer; 'that much is fair'.

hindi: सर जैसे मंगल नाभि है हमारी तो नाभि पे हम ऑयलिंग करते हैं।
says: Student premise, accepted in the class: Mars signifies the navel of the body, and oil application on the navel is therefore a Mars-related act.
ambiguity: Said by a student, not the instructor; instructor's next answers build on it.
classical_check: Partly differs: classical kala-purusha puts Mars on blood, marrow and the stomach/navel region only loosely; the navel is not a standard Mars karaka.

hindi: तो अगर हम सरसों का तेल लगाएं जो कि शनि रूप है।
says: Student states mustard oil is a Saturn substance, so applying it on the navel brings Saturn onto Mars's seat.
ambiguity: Student's statement; instructor does not object.
classical_check: Agrees in tradition: mustard oil is associated with Saturn in lal-kitab style remedies; not in Parashara.

hindi: तो मंगल पे शनि लगाने से शनि टेक्निकली नीच का हो जाता है। तो
says: Student's logic: Saturn placed on Mars's domain becomes technically debilitated (Saturn is debilitated in Mars's sign Aries), so mustard oil on the navel would weaken Saturn.
ambiguity: Debilitation is by sign (Saturn in Aries); the student extends it to a body part. Caption continues in next chunk.
classical_check: Agrees on the fact that Saturn is debilitated in Aries; the body-part extension is not classical.

gist: Student finishes by asking whether this is right or whether ghee should be applied instead.

hindi: गैस्ट्रिक प्रॉब्लम्स है तो उसके लिए नाभि पे शनि लगाओ।
says: For gastric trouble, he says apply a Saturn substance (mustard oil) on the navel. This is his tradition claim, not medical advice, and is recorded only as said.
ambiguity: 'Saturn' is read as mustard oil from the previous question.
classical_check: Silent: no classical text; health claim is folk practice.

hindi: आपको बढ़ाना है इस नाभिक की शक्ति को तो घी लगाओ।
says: To increase the strength of the navel centre (Mars energy), apply ghee on the navel.
classical_check: Silent: folk/ayurvedic practice, not Jyotish text.

hindi: आपको इसको कूल डाउन स्मूथ रखना है, ठंडा करना है तो बेबी ऑयल लगाओ।
says: To keep the navel centre cool and smooth (reduce Mars heat), use baby oil on the navel.
ambiguity: Baby oil is treated as a cooling (Moon/Venus type) substance; he does not name the planet.

hindi: आपको इसके अंदर बर्निंग बढ़ानी है और ज्यादा तो ग्रीन वाला आंवले का तेल लगाओ।
says: To increase the burning (Mars fire) further, apply green amla oil on the navel; contrasted with the cooling baby oil.
ambiguity: Caption 'ग्रीन वाला आंवले का तेल' is slightly garbled; amla oil is normally cooling, so the claim looks odd.
classical_check: Silent; amla oil is traditionally cooling, so this seems to differ from common usage.

hindi: इसीलिए घी बेस्टेस्ट मानते हैं।
says: Conclusion: because ghee strengthens without turning the navel into a Saturn or an over-cooled state, ghee is regarded as the best navel application.
